en.s: The conquest of Wu by Jin was a military campaign launched by the Jin dynasty against the state of Wu from late 279 to mid 280 at the end of the Three Kingdoms period of China. The campaign, which started in December 279 or January 280, concluded with complete victory for the Jin dynasty on 1 May 280 when the Wu emperor Sun Hao surrendered.

zh.s: 晋灭吴之战是中国三国时期末期，晋朝于279年末至280年中发动的一场针对吴国的军事行动。战役于279年12月或280年1月开始，至280年5月1日以吴帝孙皓投降、晋朝取得全面胜利而告终。

en.s: This Battle of Rayy (one among many) was fought on May 1, 811 AD as part of an Abbasid civil war (the "Fourth Fitna") between the two half-brothers, al-Amin and al-Ma'mun.

zh.s: 这场雷伊战役（历史上众多同名战役之一）于公元811年5月1日爆发，是阿拔斯王朝内战“四次内乱”期间，半兄弟阿明与马蒙之间的一场战役。

en.s: The Battle of Cresson was a small battle, fought on 1 May 1187 at the springs of Cresson, or 'Ain Gozeh, near Nazareth. It was a prelude to the decisive defeat of the Kingdom of Jerusalem at the Battle of Hattin two months later.

zh.s: 克雷松战役于1187年5月1日在拿撒勒附近的克雷松泉（又称艾因·戈泽）发生，规模较小。两个月后，耶路撒冷王国在哈丁战役中遭遇决定性败绩；克雷松战役是此前的一场战斗。

en.s: The Battle of Forlì in 1282 took place between an army recruited in France, sent by Pope Martin IV in an attempt to subdue Forlì and the Ghibellines. The Guelph army was defeated thanks to the strategic ability of Guido I da Montefeltro.

zh.s: 1282年的福尔利战役中，教皇马丁四世派遣一支从法国招募的军队，试图征服福尔利和归尔甫派。归尔甫派军队最终落败，归功于圭多一世·达·蒙特费尔特罗的战略指挥。

The war ended in a Hungarian victory, as the armies of Louis I dealt a blow in Bulgaria not only to the Turks, but also to the Bulgarian ruler Ivan Shisman, who was allied with them in 1377.

en.s: The Battle of Arkinholm was fought on 1 May 1455, at Arkinholm near Langholm in Scotland, during the reign of King James II of Scotland. Although a small action, involving only a few hundred troops, it was the decisive battle in a civil war between the king and the Black Douglases, the most powerful aristocratic family in the country. As the king's supporters won it was a significant step in the struggle to establish a relatively strong centralised monarchy in Scotland during the Late Middle Ages. The Black Douglases had already suffered some losses before the battle.

zh.s: 阿金霍尔姆战役于1455年5月1日在苏格兰朗霍姆附近的阿金霍尔姆发生，当时苏格兰国王詹姆斯二世在位。虽然战斗规模不大，双方只有数百人参战，但它是国王与国内最有势力的贵族家族“黑道格拉斯家族”内战中的决定性一战。国王支持者获胜后，苏格兰在中世纪晚期逐步建立较强中央王权的进程迈出重要一步。黑道格拉斯家族在战前已遭受一些损失。

en.s: The Alhambra Decree (also known as the Edict of Expulsion; Spanish: Decreto de la Alhambra, Edicto de Granada) was an edict issued on 31 March 1492 by the joint Catholic Monarchs of Spain, Isabella I of Castile and Ferdinand II of Aragon, ordering the expulsion of unconverted Jews from the Crowns of Castile and Aragon and its territories and possessions by 31 July of that year.

zh.t: 驱逐令在卡斯蒂利亚正式公布，要求所有犹太居民在三个月内离境
zh.s: 《阿尔罕布拉诏令》也称驱逐令（西班牙语：Decreto de la Alhambra、Edicto de Granada），由西班牙天主教双王卡斯蒂利亚的伊莎贝拉一世和阿拉贡的斐迪南二世于1492年3月31日颁布，命令未改宗的犹太人于当年7月31日前离开卡斯蒂利亚和阿拉贡王国及其领地和属地。

en.s: The Battle of Szőlős or Battle of Seleš (Hungarian: Szőlősi csata, Serbian: Селешка битка (Seleška bitka)) was fought on May 1, 1527 between the ethnic Serbian Rebels and Hungarian nobility. The commander of the Serb forces was Emperor Jovan Nenad, while the Hungarians were led by Péter Perényi of Transylvania. The Hungarian army suffered a total defeat while Perényi barely escaped alive.

zh.s: 瑟勒什战役又称塞莱什战役（匈牙利语：Szőlősi csata；塞尔维亚语：Селешка битка，转写为Seleška bitka），于1527年5月1日爆发，交战双方是塞尔维亚族叛军和匈牙利贵族。塞尔维亚军队由皇帝约万·内纳德指挥，匈牙利军队则由特兰西瓦尼亚的彼得·佩雷尼率领。匈牙利军队惨败，佩雷尼侥幸逃生。

en.s: The Sack of Lanzarote occurred in 1618, when 36 Algerian galleys sacked the island of Lanzarote in the Canary Islands, taking 900 men, women and children with them to be sold.

en.s: The recapture of Bahia (Portuguese: Jornada dos Vassalos; Spanish: Jornada del Brasil) was a Spanish–Portuguese military expedition in 1625 to retake the city of Bahia (now Salvador) in Brazil from the forces of the Dutch West India Company (WIC). In May 1624, Dutch WIC forces under Jacob Willekens captured Salvador from the Portuguese.

en.t: Skirmish at the Isle of Wight
en.s: The skirmish at the Isle of Wight (Swedish: Skärmytsling vid Isle of Wight) was a brief naval skirmish between Swedish and English warships off the Isle of Wight on 1 May 1647 during the English Civil War. It ended with the Swedish outrunning their English pursuers, although one Swedish warship was later taken by the English into the Downs on 3 May after being discovered at anchor in Boulogne-sur-Mer.

zh.t: 怀特岛海上小规模交战
zh.s: 怀特岛海上小规模交战（瑞典语：Skärmytsling vid Isle of Wight）于1647年5月1日、英国内战期间在怀特岛附近海域发生，是瑞典与英国军舰之间的一次短暂海战。瑞典舰船甩开英国追兵后脱险，但5月3日，一艘瑞典军舰在加来海峡布洛涅-sur-Mer锚泊时被英国人发现并俘获。

en.s: In the siege of Candia (now Heraklion, Crete), Ottoman forces besieged the Venetian-ruled capital city of the Kingdom of Candia. It lasted from 1648 to 1669 (a total of 21 years) and is one of the longest sieges in history. It ended with an Ottoman victory, but the effort and cost of the siege contributed to the decline of the Ottoman Empire, especially after the Great Turkish War.

zh.s: 坎迪亚围城战中，奥斯曼军队围攻威尼斯统治下坎迪亚王国的首都（今克里特岛伊拉克利翁）。围城从1648年持续到1669年，共21年，是历史上持续时间最长的围城战之一。围城最终以奥斯曼获胜告终，但围城付出的代价加速了奥斯曼帝国衰落，尤其是在大土耳其战争之后。

en.s: The Battle of Iași took place on May 1, 1653, during Moldavian campaign of Tymofiy Khmelnytsky. In April 1653, the Cossack-Tatar corps led by Tymofiy Khmelnytsky entered the territory of Moldova to return the lost throne of the principality to his father-in-law Vasile Lupu.

en.s: The Battle of Cromdale took place at the Haughs of Cromdale on 30 April and 1 May 1690. The site is on a hillside near the village of Cromdale, Strathspey, historically within the county of Inverness-shire. The battlefield has been included in the Inventory of Historic Battlefields in Scotland and protected by Historic Scotland under the Scottish Historical Environment Policy of 2009.

zh.s: 克罗姆代尔战役于1690年4月30日至5月1日在克罗姆代尔高地进行。战场位于斯特拉斯佩克罗姆代尔村附近的山坡上，历史上属因弗内斯郡。该战场已列入苏格兰历史战场名录，并依据苏格兰2009年历史环境政策受到苏格兰历史古迹保护机构保护。

en.t: The Act of Union joining England and Scotland to form the Kingdom of Great Britain takes effect
en.s: Great Britain, officially the Kingdom of Great Britain, was a sovereign state in Western Europe from 1707 to the end of 1800. The state was created by the 1706 Treaty of Union and ratified by the Acts of Union 1707, which united the Kingdom of England (including Wales) and the Kingdom of Scotland to form a single kingdom encompassing the whole island of Great Britain and its outlying islands, with the exception of the Isle of Man and the Channel Islands.

zh.t: 英格兰与苏格兰合并，大不列颠王国成立
zh.s: 大不列颠王国（官方名称为大不列颠联合王国）是1707年至1800年底存在于西欧的主权国家。该国由1706年《合并条约》创建，并经1707年《合并法案》批准。两部法律将英格兰王国（包括威尔士）和苏格兰王国合并为一个统一王国，涵盖大不列颠全岛及周边岛屿，但不包括马恩岛和海峡群岛。

en.s: The invasion of Guadeloupe was a military action from January to May 1759, as part of the Seven Years' War. A large British force had arrived in the West Indies, intending to seize French possessions. After a six-month-long battle to capture Guadeloupe they finally received the formal surrender of the island, just days before a large French relief force arrived under Admiral Maximin de Bompart.

en.s: The Battle of Crooked Billet was a battle in the Philadelphia campaign of the American Revolutionary War fought on May 1, 1778 near the Crooked Billet Tavern (present-day Hatboro, Pennsylvania). In the skirmish action, British forces under the command of Major John Graves Simcoe launched a surprise attack against Brigadier General John Lacey and three regiments of Pennsylvania militia, who were literally caught sleeping. The British inflicted significant damage, and Lacey and his forces were forced to retreat into neighboring Bucks County.

zh.s: 弯弯木栅栏战役是美国独立战争费城战役的一场战斗，于1778年5月1日在今宾夕法尼亚州哈特伯勒附近的弯弯木栅栏酒馆发生。约翰·格雷夫斯·西姆科少校率领的英军突袭约翰·莱西准将和三支宾夕法尼亚民兵团，他们当时正在睡觉。英军造成重大损失，莱西及其部队被迫撤往邻近的巴克斯县。

en.s: The Action of 1 May 1781 was a minor naval engagement nearly 210 miles off the Port of Brest in which HMS Canada, a 74-gun third rate of the Royal Navy under Captain George Collier chased, intercepted and captured the 40-gun Spanish frigate Santa Leocadia, captained by Don Francisco de Wenthuisen.

en.s: The Battle of Scapezzano was a short engagement in the Neapolitan War on 1 May 1815 between an Austrian corps under Adam Albert von Neipperg and Neapolitan division under Michele Carascosa. By May 1815, the war had turned against the Neapolitans and Murat had been driven back to his original headquarters in Ancona. However, the two pursuing Austrian corps under the command of Neipperg and Bianchi had become separated by the Apennine Mountains. Neipperg's force of 15,300 had directly followed the retreating Neapolitans along the Adriatic coast, whilst Bianchi's force of 12,000 had marched on Foligno, in the centre of Italy, to cut off the line of retreat back to Naples.

zh.s: 斯卡佩扎诺战役是那不勒斯战争中的一场短暂交战，于1815年5月1日爆发，交战双方是亚当·阿尔贝特·冯·奈佩格率领的奥地利军团和米凯莱·卡拉斯科萨率领的那不勒斯师。1815年5月，战局已对那不勒斯不利，缪拉被迫撤回安科纳原先的总部。追击他的奈佩格和比安基率领的两支奥地利军队被亚平宁山脉分隔。奈佩格的15300人沿亚得里亚海岸直接追击撤退的那不勒斯军队；比安基的12000人则向意大利中部的福利尼奥进军，切断那不勒斯军队的退路。

en.t: Execution of the Cato Street Conspirators, who plotted to kill the British Cabinet and Prime Minister Lord Liverpool
en.s: The Cato Street Conspiracy was a plot to murder all the British cabinet ministers and the Prime Minister Lord Liverpool in 1820. The name comes from the meeting place near Edgware Road in London. The police had an informer; the plotters fell into a police trap. Thirteen were arrested, while one policeman, Richard Smithers, was killed. Five conspirators were executed, and five others were transported to Australia.

zh.t: 卡托街阴谋案涉案者被处决
zh.s: 1820年，卡托街阴谋案的参与者计划杀害英国所有内阁大臣和首相利物浦勋爵。阴谋案因伦敦埃奇韦尔路附近的集会地点而得名。警方安插了线人，参与者落入警方圈套。13人被捕，一名警员理查德·史密瑟斯被杀。5名参与者被处决，另外5人被流放到澳大利亚。

en.t: Formal establishment of the Hong Kong Police Force
en.s: The Hong Kong Police Force (HKPF) is the primary law enforcement, investigative agency, and largest disciplined service under the Security Bureau of Hong Kong. Pursuant to the one country, two systems principle, the HKPF is officially independent of the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Public Security of the People's Republic of China, which under usual circumstances may not interfere with Hong Kong’s local law enforcement matters.

en.s: Federal elections were held in all the 38 states of the German Confederation on 1 May 1848 to elect members of a new National Assembly known as the Frankfurt Parliament. The ballot was not secret, and elected 585 members, mostly from the middle class.

zh.s: 1848年5月1日，德意志邦联的38个邦均举行选举，选出新国民议会成员，该议会又称法兰克福议会。投票不采用秘密投票方式，共选出585名议员，多数来自中产阶级。

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia on 1 May 1849, alongside a constitutional referendum. The result was a victory for incumbent President Joseph Jenkins Roberts.

zh.s: 1849年5月1日，利比里亚举行大选，并同时举行宪法公投。时任总统约瑟夫·詹金斯·罗伯茨获胜。

en.t: Queen Victoria opens The Great Exhibition at The Crystal Palace in London
en.s: Victoria (Alexandrina Victoria; 24 May 1819 – 22 January 1901) was Queen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland from 20 June 1837 until her death in 1901. Her reign of 63 years and 216 days, which was longer than those of any of her predecessors, constituted the Victorian era, a period of industrial, political, scientific, and military change within the United Kingdom marked by a great expansion of the British Empire.

zh.t: 维多利亚女王开启水晶宫万国工业博览会
zh.s: 维多利亚（亚历山德丽娜·维多利亚；1819年5月24日—1901年1月22日）自1837年6月20日起担任大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国女王，直至1901年去世。在位63年216天，超过她之前的所有君主。她的统治时期被称为维多利亚时代，英国经历了工业、政治、科学和军事变革，大英帝国也大幅扩张。

en.s: The Great Exhibition of the Works of Industry of All Nations, also known as the Great Exhibition or the Crystal Palace Exhibition (in reference to the temporary structure in which it was held), was an international exhibition that took place in Hyde Park, London, from 1 May to 15 October 1851. It was the first in a series of world's fairs, exhibitions of culture and industry that became popular in the 19th century.

zh.s: 万国工业博览会又称万国博览会或水晶宫博览会（以举办展览的临时建筑命名），于1851年5月1日至10月15日在伦敦海德公园举行。这是世界博览会系列中的首届。此类展示文化和工业成果的博览会在19世纪逐渐流行。

en.s: The Battle of Port Gibson was fought near Port Gibson, Mississippi, on May 1, 1863, between Union and Confederate forces during the Vicksburg Campaign of the American Civil War. The Union Army was led by Maj. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant, and was victorious.

zh.s: 吉布森港战役于1863年5月1日在密西西比州吉布森港附近发生，是美国内战维克斯堡战役的一部分。联邦军和邦联军在此交战。联邦军由尤利西斯·格兰特少将率领，最终获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Anderson was a minor skirmish during the American Civil War, fought in Anderson County, South Carolina, on May 1, 1865. The battle was one of the final conflicts of the war, taking place three weeks after Robert E. Lee surrendered to Ulysses S. Grant at Appomattox Court House.

zh.s: 安德森战役是美国内战期间的一场小规模战斗，于1865年5月1日在南卡罗来纳州安德森县发生。这是战争最后几场冲突之一，距罗伯特·E·李在阿波马托克斯法院向尤利西斯·格兰特投降已过去三周。

en.s: The Treaty of the Triple Alliance allied the Empire of Brazil, Argentina, and Uruguay against Paraguay. Signed in 1865, after the outbreak of the Paraguayan War, its articles (plus a Protocol) prescribed the allies' actions both during and after the war. An English translation of the text is reproduced in this article. The war lasted until 1870 and led to the near-annihilation of Paraguay.
en.n: The Empire of Brazil, Argentina, and Uruguay sign the Treaty of the Triple Alliance.

zh.s: 三国同盟条约使巴西帝国、阿根廷和乌拉圭结盟，对抗巴拉圭。该条约于巴拉圭战争爆发后的1865年签署，其中的条款和一份议定书规定了盟国在战争期间及战后的行动。本文附有条约英文译文。战争持续到1870年，导致巴拉圭几乎覆亡。
zh.n: 巴西帝国、阿根廷和乌拉圭签署三国同盟条约。

en.s: A by-election was held on 1 May 1866 to return an MP for the constituency of Helston, England. The by-election was caused by the declaration that Adolphus Young's election in the 1865 United Kingdom general election was null and void due to bribery. Two candidates contested the election: Robert Campbell for the Liberal Party and William Baliol Brett for the Conservatives.

zh.s: 1866年5月1日，英格兰赫尔斯顿选区举行补选，选出一名英国下议院议员。此前，阿道弗斯·杨在1865年英国大选中的当选因贿选被宣布无效，因此举行补选。参选者有两人：自由党候选人罗伯特·坎贝尔和保守党候选人威廉·巴利奥尔·布雷特。

en.s: The 1878 Quebec general election was held on May 1, 1878 to elect members of the 4th Legislative Assembly for the Province of Quebec, Canada. The result was a hung parliament, with no party having a clear majority. Only one seat divided the two major parties, the Quebec Conservative Party and the Quebec Liberal Party. The balance of power was held by two Independent Conservatives.

zh.s: 1878年魁北克大选于1878年5月1日举行，选出加拿大魁北克省第四届立法议会议员。选举结果形成悬峙议会，没有政党取得明确多数。魁北克保守党和魁北克自由党这两大党之间只差一个席位，权力平衡由两名独立保守党议员掌握。

en.s: The Battle of Manila Bay took place on 1 May 1898, during the Spanish–American War. The American Asiatic Squadron under Commodore George Dewey engaged and destroyed the Spanish Pacific Squadron under Admiral Patricio Montojo. The battle took place in Manila Bay in the Philippines, and was the first major engagement of the Spanish–American War.

zh.s: 马尼拉湾海战于1898年5月1日、西班牙—美国战争期间爆发。乔治·杜威准将率领的美国亚洲舰队与帕特里西奥·蒙托霍海军上将指挥的西班牙太平洋舰队交战，并将其摧毁。战斗发生在菲律宾马尼拉湾，是西班牙—美国战争的首场重大交战。

en.s: The Scofield Mine disaster was a mining explosion that occurred at the Winter Quarters coal mine on May 1, 1900. The mine was located at 39°42′57″N 111°11′17″W near the town of Scofield, Utah. In terms of life lost, it was the worst mining accident at that point in American history. The explosion is also a key element in the plot of the Carla Kelly novel My Loving Vigil Keeping.

zh.s: 斯科菲尔德矿难是1900年5月1日冬季矿区煤矿发生的一起爆炸事故。煤矿位于美国犹他州斯科菲尔德镇附近，坐标为北纬39°42′57″、西经111°11′17″。按死亡人数计算，这是当时美国历史上最严重的矿难。这次爆炸也是卡拉·凯利小说《我爱的守望》的重要情节。

en.s: The Battle of the Yalu River (Amnok River) lasted from April 30 to May 1, 1904 and was the first major land battle during the Russo-Japanese War. It was fought near Wiju (modern village of Sinuiju, North Korea) on the lower reaches of the Yalu River, on the border between Korea and China. Also known as the Yalu River Crossing Operation.

en.s: The Évence Coppée Trophy (French: Trophée Évence Coppée) was a one-off competition comprising a single association football match in 1904 between Belgium and France. Held at the Stade du Vivier d'Oie in Uccle, Belgium, the match ended in a 3–3 draw. The trophy was named after Évence Coppée, the Belgian patron who organised the match to promote Franco-Belgian friendship.

zh.s: 埃旺斯·科佩奖杯赛（法语：Trophée Évence Coppée）是1904年举办的一次性赛事，只进行了一场比利时对法国的足球比赛。比赛在比利时于克勒的维维耶德瓦球场举行，双方以3比3战平。奖杯以比利时赞助人埃旺斯·科佩命名，他组织这场比赛是为了促进法比友好。

en.s: The Battle of Kaçanik Pass (Albanian: Beteja e Grykës së Kaçanikut) was a battle between Albanian rebels and Ottoman forces during the Revolt of 1910. The clashes represented a series of military offensives launched by Shevket Turgut Pasha against Albanian rebels that blocked the railway to Skopje at the Kaçanik Pass.

en.s: The 1917 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on May 1, 1917. Incumbent Frederic T. Woodman, who was appointed after the resignation of Charles E. Sebastian, was re-elected over former Mayor Meredith P. Snyder. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

zh.s: 1917年洛杉矶市长选举于1917年5月1日举行。现任市长弗雷德里克·T·伍德曼是在查尔斯·E·塞巴斯蒂安辞职后获任命上任，他在选举中击败前市长梅雷迪思·P·斯奈德，成功连任。加利福尼亚州的市政选举（包括洛杉矶市长选举）依法不设党派标签，候选人的党派不会出现在选票上。

en.s: Battle of Lahti was a 1918 Finnish Civil War battle, fought from 19 April to 1 May by the German troops and Finnish Whites against the Finnish Reds in Lahti, Finland. Together with the Battle of Viipuri, from 24 to 29 April, it was the last major battle of the war. The German unit Detachment Brandenstein, commanded by colonel Otto von Brandenstein, attacked Lahti on 19 April, taking the town by the next evening.

zh.s: 拉赫蒂战役是芬兰内战中的一场战役，德国军队和芬兰白军于1918年4月19日至5月1日在芬兰拉赫蒂与芬兰红军交战。与4月24日至29日的维堡战役一同，这场战役是战争最后阶段的主要战斗。4月19日，奥托·冯·布兰登施泰因上校指挥的德国布兰登施泰因支队进攻拉赫蒂，次日晚占领该镇。

Farmer and former Indiana Senator Edward E. Moore. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

zh.s: 1923年洛杉矶市长选举于1923年5月1日举行。现任市长乔治·E·克莱尔击败四名对手，成功连任。对手包括前市议员伯特·L·法默和前印第安纳州参议员爱德华·E·摩尔。加利福尼亚州的市政选举（包括洛杉矶市长选举）依法不设党派标签，候选人的党派不会出现在选票上。

en.t: Establishment of All-China Federation of Trade Unions
en.s: The All-China Federation of Trade Unions (ACFTU) is the national trade union center and people's organization of the People's Republic of China, led by the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). It is the largest trade union in the world with 302 million members in 1,713,000 primary trade union organizations. The ACFTU is divided into 31 regional federations and 10 national industrial unions.

zh.s: 中华全国总工会（ACFTU）是中华人民共和国全国性工会组织，由中国共产党领导。它是全球会员人数最多的工会组织，拥有3.02亿名会员，分布在171.3万个基层工会组织中。中华全国总工会下辖31个地方总工会和10个全国性产业工会。

en.s: The Empire State Building is a 102-story, supertall skyscraper in the Midtown South neighborhood of Manhattan, New York City, United States. The building was designed in the Art Deco style by Shreve, Lamb & Harmon and constructed between 1930 and 1931. Its name is derived from "Empire State", the nickname of New York state.

en.s: The 1937 FA Cup final was contested by Sunderland and Preston North End on 1 May 1937 at Wembley. It was the 62nd FA Cup Final and the first to be played in May. The match took place eleven days before the coronation of George VI and Queen Elizabeth, who were the guests of honour.

zh.s: 1937年英格兰足总杯决赛于1937年5月1日在温布利举行，由桑德兰对阵普雷斯顿北区。这是第62届足总杯决赛，也是首次在5月举行。比赛在乔治六世和伊丽莎白王后加冕礼前11天举行，两人是决赛的贵宾。

en.t: Citizen Kane, a widely acclaimed film by actor and director Orson Welles, premiered
en.s: Citizen Kane is a 1941 American drama film directed, produced by, and starring Orson Welles and co-written by Welles and Herman J. Mankiewicz, and was Welles's first feature film. The quasi-biographical film examines the life and legacy of Charles Foster Kane, played by Welles, a composite character based on American media barons William Randolph Hearst and Joseph Pulitzer, and Chicago tycoons Samuel Insull and Harold McCormick, as well as aspects of the screenwriters' own lives.

zh.s: 《公民凯恩》是一部1941年美国剧情片，由奥逊·威尔斯执导、制作并主演，剧本由威尔斯和赫尔曼·J·曼凯维奇共同编写，也是威尔斯的首部长片。影片带有准传记性质，讲述查尔斯·福斯特·凯恩的一生与遗产；凯恩由威尔斯饰演，是以美国传媒大亨威廉·伦道夫·赫斯特和约瑟夫·普利策、芝加哥实业家塞缪尔·英萨尔和哈罗德·麦考密克，以及编剧本人的部分经历为原型的综合人物。

The convoy route was a milk run and Convoy TS 37 had to make do with four small escort ships and relays of aircraft from the airfields along the West African coast.

zh.s: TS 37船队是1943年4月30日至5月1日航行于南大西洋的一支船队。第二次世界大战期间，TS系列船队往返于加纳塔科拉迪和塞拉利昂弗里敦之间。该航线相对安全，TS 37船队只有四艘小型护航舰，并由西非沿岸机场派出的飞机轮流提供空中掩护。

en.s: The Battle of Elephant Point was an airborne operation conducted by a composite Gurkha airborne battalion that took place on 1 May 1945. In March 1945, plans were made for an assault on Rangoon, the capital of Burma, as a stepping-stone on the way to recapturing Malaya and Singapore. Initial plans for the assault on the city had called for a purely land-based approach by British Fourteenth Army, but concerns about heavy Japanese resistance led to this being modified with the addition of a joint amphibious-airborne assault.

zh.s: 大象角战役是一场空降行动，于1945年5月1日由一支廓尔喀混编空降营执行。1945年3月，盟军计划进攻缅甸首都仰光，为收复马来亚和新加坡铺路。最初计划仅由英国第十四集团军从陆路进攻；由于担心日军抵抗激烈，计划后来增加了两栖和空降联合攻击。

en.s: The Battle of Halbe (German: Kesselschlacht von Halbe, Battle of the Halbe Pocket; Russian: Хальбский котёл, Halbe pocket) was a battle lasting from April 24 to May 1, 1945, in which the German Ninth Army under the command of General Theodor Busse was destroyed as a fighting force by the advancing Red Army during the Battle of Berlin.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 哈贝战役（德语：Kesselschlacht von Halbe，即哈贝包围圈战役；俄语：Хальбский котёл，即哈贝包围圈）于1945年4月24日至5月1日进行。柏林战役期间，红军不断推进，西奥多·布塞将军指挥的德国第九集团军最终失去作战能力。

en.s: The Pilbara strike was a landmark strike by Aboriginal Australian pastoral workers in the Pilbara region of Western Australia. The strike lasted between 1946 and 1949, and was the longest industrial action in Australian history. The strikers demanded social recognition, payment of fair wages, and an improvement in working conditions. Participating in the strike were 800 Aboriginal pastoral workers who walked off the large pastoral stations in the Pilbara on 1 May 1946, and also from employment in the two major towns of Port Hedland and Marble Bar.

zh.s: 皮尔巴拉罢工是澳大利亚西澳大利亚州皮尔巴拉地区原住民牧场工人发起的一场重要罢工。罢工从1946年持续到1949年，是澳大利亚历史上持续时间最长的劳工行动。罢工者要求获得社会认可、得到公平工资并改善工作条件。1946年5月1日，800名原住民牧场工人离开皮尔巴拉的大型牧场；另有工人离开黑德兰港和马布尔巴两座主要城镇的工作岗位，参加罢工。

en.s: The Portella della Ginestra massacre refers to the killing of 11 people and wounding of 27 others during May Day celebrations in Sicily on 1 May 1947, in the municipality of Piana degli Albanesi. Those held responsible were the bandit and separatist leader Salvatore Giuliano and his gang, although their motives and intentions are still a matter of controversy.

zh.t: 波特拉德拉吉内斯特拉大屠杀
zh.s: 1947年5月1日，西西里皮亚纳德利阿尔巴内西市镇举行五一庆祝活动期间，11人被杀、27人受伤，这起事件被称为波特拉德拉吉内斯特拉大屠杀。被认定对此负责的是劫匪兼分离主义领袖萨尔瓦托雷·朱利亚诺及其团伙，但他们的动机和意图至今仍有争议。

en.s: The Battle of Hainan Island (simplified Chinese: 海南岛战役; traditional Chinese: 海南島戰役) occurred in 1950, during the final phase of the Chinese Civil War. The People's Republic of China (PRC) conducted an amphibious assault on Hainan Island on 16 April, assisted by the Hainan communist movement which controlled much of the island's interior, while the Republic of China (ROC) controlled the coast; their forces were concentrated in the north near Haikou and were forced to retreat south after the landings.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 海南岛战役发生于1950年中国内战的最后阶段。中华人民共和国军队于4月16日发起登陆进攻，海南岛上的共产党力量协助作战，并控制岛屿内陆的大部分地区；中华民国军队控制沿海，兵力集中在海口附近，登陆后被迫向南撤退。

en.s: An election to the Aberdeen Corporation was held on 1 May 1951, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. 14 of the corporation's 37 seats were up for election. The election saw the Progressives make a one-seat gain on Labour, increasing their majority to 3. This election was the first that the Scottish National Party ran a candidate in Aberdeen local elections, doing so in the Woodside ward where the candidate placed last.

zh.s: 1951年5月1日，阿伯丁市议会举行选举，与苏格兰各地市政选举同时进行。市议会37个席位中有14席改选。进步党从工党手中赢得一席，多数席位增至3席。这是苏格兰民族党首次派候选人参加阿伯丁地方选举，候选人在伍德赛德选区排名最后。

en.s: The 1953 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1952–53 DFB-Pokal, the 10th season of Germany's knockout football cup competition. It was played on 1 May 1953 at the Rheinstadion in Düsseldorf. Rot-Weiss Essen won the match 2–1 against Alemannia Aachen, to claim their 1st cup title.

zh.s: 1953年德国足协杯决赛决出了1952—53赛季德国足协杯冠军，这是德国淘汰制足球杯赛的第10个赛季。比赛于1953年5月1日在杜塞尔多夫的莱茵体育场举行，红白埃森以2比1击败亚琛，首次夺得杯赛冠军。

en.s: The 1954 FA Cup final was a football match between West Bromwich Albion and Preston North End, played on 1 May 1954 at the original Wembley Stadium in London. It was the final match of the 1953–54 staging of English football's primary cup competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup (better known as the FA Cup). The match was the 73rd FA Cup Final and the 26th to be played at Wembley.

zh.s: 1954年英格兰足总杯决赛于1954年5月1日在伦敦旧温布利球场举行，对阵双方是西布罗姆维奇和普雷斯顿北区。这是1953—54赛季英格兰主要足球杯赛——英格兰足总挑战杯（简称足总杯）的决赛，也是第73届足总杯决赛、第26次在温布利举行的决赛。

en.s: An election to the Aberdeen Corporation was held on 1 May 1956, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. 12 of the corporation's 37 seats were up for election, although only 6 were contested. This election set a record for low turnout rate for the third year in a row, with turnout dropping to below 20% for the first time ever.

zh.s: 1956年5月1日，阿伯丁市议会举行选举，与苏格兰各地市政选举同时进行。市议会37个席位中有12席改选，但只有6席有竞争。投票率连续第三年创下新低，并首次跌破20%。

en.s: The 1957 Blackbushe Viking accident occurred on 1 May 1957 when an Eagle Aviation twin-engined Vickers VC.1 Viking registered G-AJBO crashed into trees near Blackbushe Airport, located in Hampshire, England, on approach following a suspected engine failure on take-off. All five crew and 29 of the 30 passengers were killed.

zh.t: 1957年布莱克布什机场维京客机事故
zh.s: 1957年5月1日，一架隶属鹰航空、注册编号G-AJBO的维克斯VC.1“维京”双发客机在英格兰汉普郡布莱克布什机场附近进近时撞上树木坠毁，事故原因疑为起飞时发动机故障。机上5名机组人员和30名乘客中的29人遇难。

en.s: The Cuban invasion of Panama was a military operation carried out in April 1959 in which Cuban troops, along with some Panamanian guerrillas, sought to initiate a revolution in Panama modeled after the Cuban example. The mission was led by Panamanian Enrique Morales in support of a coup attempt by Roberto Arias.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 古巴入侵巴拿马是1959年4月的一次军事行动。古巴军队和部分巴拿马游击队试图仿效古巴模式，在巴拿马发动革命。行动由巴拿马人恩里克·莫拉莱斯领导，目的是支持罗伯托·阿里亚斯发动政变。

en.t: An American U-2 reconnaissance aircraft is shot down
en.s: A US U-2 reconnaissance aircraft was shot down over the Soviet Union. Its pilot, Francis Gary Powers, was captured, and the incident caused a major diplomatic confrontation between the United States and the Soviet Union.

zh.s: 一架美国U-2侦察机在苏联上空被击落，飞行员弗朗西斯·加里·鲍尔斯被俘。这起事件引发美国与苏联之间的重大外交对峙。

en.s: An election to the Edinburgh Corporation was held on 1 May 1962, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. Of the councils 69 seats, 23 were up for election. After the election Edinburgh Corporation was composed of 34 Progressives, 30 Labour councillors, and 5 Liberals. The Progressives lost their overall majority on the council.

zh.s: 1962年5月1日，爱丁堡市议会举行选举，与苏格兰各地市政选举同时进行。议会69个席位中有23席改选。选举后，爱丁堡市议会由34名进步党议员、30名工党议员和5名自由党议员组成。进步党失去议会多数席位。

en.s: The Battle of Dong-Yin (東引海戰) was a naval conflict between forces of the Republic of China Navy and the People's Liberation Army Navy around Dongyin island, Fukien Province, Republic of China on May 1, 1965. Both sides subsequently claimed victory.

zh.s: 东引海战（中文：東引海戰）于1965年5月1日在东引岛附近海域发生，是中华民国海军与中国人民解放军海军之间的一场海战。双方随后都宣称获胜。

en.s: The 1965 FA Cup final was an association football match between Leeds United and Liverpool on 1 May 1965 at Wembley Stadium, London. It was the final match of the 1964–65 FA Cup, the 93rd season of England's primary cup competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup, better known as the FA Cup. Liverpool were appearing in their third final, having lost the previous two in 1914 and 1950, while Leeds were appearing in their first.

zh.s: 1965年英格兰足总杯决赛于1965年5月1日在伦敦温布利球场举行，对阵双方是利兹联和利物浦。这是1964—65赛季英格兰足总杯的决赛，也是这项英格兰主要杯赛的第93个赛季。利物浦此前曾两次闯入决赛，分别在1914年和1950年落败；利兹联则首次闯入决赛。

en.s: The 1965 New South Wales state election was held on 1 May 1965. It was conducted in single member constituencies with compulsory preferential voting and was held on boundaries created at a 1961 redistribution. The election was for all of the 94 seats in the Legislative Assembly.

zh.s: 1965年新南威尔士州选举于1965年5月1日举行，选举新南威尔士州立法议会全部94个席位。选举在单一议员选区进行，采用强制偏好投票制，选区边界沿用1961年重新划分后的方案。

en.t: Vietnam War: A student anti-war strike erupts in response to U.S. and South Vietnamese forces attacking Vietnamese communists in a Cambodian Campaign
en.s: The Vietnam War (c. 1955 – 30 April 1975) was an armed conflict in Vietnam, Laos, and Cambodia fought between North Vietnam (Democratic Republic of Vietnam) and South Vietnam (Republic of Vietnam) and their allies. North Vietnam was supported by the Soviet Union and China, while South Vietnam was supported by the United States and other anti-communist nations.

zh.t: 越南战争：学生发起反战罢课，抗议美军和南越军队在柬埔寨战役中袭击越南共产党武装
zh.s: 越南战争（约1955年—1975年4月30日）是发生在越南、老挝和柬埔寨的武装冲突，交战双方为北越（越南民主共和国）与南越（越南共和国）及其盟友。北越得到苏联和中国支持，南越则得到美国及其他反共国家支持。

en.s: An Election to the Edinburgh Corporation was held on 1 May 1973, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. Of the councils 69 seats, 26 were up for election. Labour, despite needing only 1 gain to take control of the council, failed to do so, preventing them from a historic win. Following the election, with two by-elections pending, Edinburgh Corporation was composed of 34 Labour councillors, 21 Conservatives, and 7 Liberals, with 5 others. By this point only a small rump Progressive party remained on the council, with the bulk of Progressive councillors having joined the Conservatives.

zh.s: 1973年5月1日，爱丁堡市议会举行选举，与苏格兰其他地方的市政选举同时进行。议会69个席位中有26席改选。工党只需赢得一个席位即可控制议会，但未能做到，因此未能取得历史性胜利。选举后，在两场补选尚未举行的情况下，议会由34名工党议员、21名保守党议员、7名自由党议员和5名其他党派议员组成。进步党仅剩少数议员留在议会，大多数进步党议员已加入保守党。

en.s: An election to the Aberdeen Corporation was held on 1 May 1973, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. 12 of the corporation's 36 seats were up for election. The election saw Labour remain in control of the corporation, winning 6 seats, giving them a total of 23. The Conservatives won 5 seats, including one gained from 89-year-old Independent councillor George Roberts, contributing to a total of 12 after the election.

zh.s: 1973年5月1日，阿伯丁市议会举行选举，与苏格兰各地市政选举同时进行。议会36个席位中有12席改选。工党赢得6席，累计获得23席，继续控制议会。保守党赢得5席，其中一席从89岁的独立议员乔治·罗伯茨手中夺得，选后保守党共有12席。

en.s: Local elections took place for one third of the seats of the thirty-six metropolitan boroughs on 1 May 1975. The seats had previously been contested in May 1973, when the Labour Party had achieved great success. In the 1975 elections the Conservative Party made widespread gains, with a net gain of 199 seats and Labour had a net loss of 206. The Liberal Party had a net loss of 10 seats, and Independents a loss of 5. "Others", including Ratepayers, Independent Labour councillors and Progressives made net gains of 22. The Conservatives gained control of Bury, Stockport and Wirral from no overall control; and Calderdale form Labour.

zh.s: 1975年5月1日，英国36个都市自治市中各有三分之一席位举行地方选举。这些席位上次于1973年选举，当时工党取得重大胜利。1975年选举中，保守党广泛扩大优势，净增199席；工党净失206席，自由党净失10席，无党派候选人净失5席。“其他”候选人（包括纳税人协会、独立工党议员和进步党）净增22席。保守党从没有任何政党占多数的情况中夺得伯里、斯托克波特和威勒尔的控制权，并从工党手中夺取卡尔德代尔。

en.s: Elections to Trafford Council were held on Thursday, 1 May 1975. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 1979. These were the first Borough elections to be held in Trafford since it received its Royal Charter (and effectively took over from its predecessor Districts and Municipal Boroughs) in 1974.

zh.s: 特拉福德市议会选举于1975年5月1日星期四举行，改选三分之一席位，当选者任期四年，到1979年结束。这是特拉福德获得皇家特许状后举行的首次自治市选举；特拉福德于1974年成立，接替此前的区议会和市政自治市。

en.s: Elections to Manchester Council were held on Thursday, 1 May 1975. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 1979. These were the first Borough elections to be held in Manchester since it received its new Royal Charter (and effectively took over from its predecessor Corporation) in 1974.

zh.s: 曼彻斯特市议会选举于1975年5月1日星期四举行，改选三分之一席位。当选者任期四年，到1979年结束。这是曼彻斯特于1974年获得新皇家特许状、由原市政公司改组后举行的首次自治市选举。

en.s: The 1975 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 1 May 1975 to elect members of Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1975年5月1日，英格兰威勒尔市议会举行选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: Elections to Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council were held on 1 May 1975 with one third of the seats up for election. Labour retained control of the council.

zh.s: 巴恩斯利市议会于1975年5月1日举行选举，改选三分之一席位。工党保住了议会控制权。

en.s: Elections to Stockport Council were held on Thursday, 1 May 1975. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 1979. These were the first Borough elections to be held in Stockport since it received its Royal Charter (and effectively took over from its predecessor Districts and Municipal Boroughs) in 1974.

zh.s: 斯托克波特市议会选举于1975年5月1日星期四举行，改选三分之一席位。当选者任期四年，到1979年结束。这是斯托克波特于1974年获得皇家特许状、由原区议会和市政自治市改组后举行的首次自治市选举。

en.s: The 1975 Sunderland Metropolitan Borough Council election was held on 1 May 1975. A third of the seats on the Council were up for election, with each of the 26 council wards returning one councillor by first-past-the-post. The election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1975年5月1日举行桑德兰市议会选举，改选三分之一席位。26个选区各选出一名议员，采用简单多数制。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 1 May 1975. One third of the council was up for election. The terms of office of the Councillors elected in 1973 with the third highest number of votes in each ward, expired and so these election results were compared with the 1973 results. Bill Smyth of the Liberal Party became the Leader of the Council albeit with no overall control.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于1975年5月1日举行，议会三分之一席位改选。1973年全体改选时，各选区得票第三高的当选议员任期届满，因此本次结果与1973年选举结果比较。自由党人比尔·史密斯成为议会领袖，但议会没有任何政党占多数。

en.s: A general election for the New South Wales Legislative Assembly was held in the state of New South Wales, Australia, on Saturday 1 May 1976. The result was a narrow win for the Australian Labor Party under Neville Wran—the party's first in the state in more than a decade.

zh.s: 1976年5月1日星期六，澳大利亚新南威尔士州举行立法议会选举。内维尔·沃兰领导的澳大利亚工党险胜，这是该党十多年来首次在该州获胜。

en.s: The 1976 Scottish Cup Final was played on 1 May 1976 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 91st Scottish Cup. Rangers and Hearts contested the match, Rangers won the match 3–1 with Derek Johnstone (2) and Alex MacDonald scoring for Rangers, Graham Shaw getting the goal for Hearts. Rangers dominated the game from the whistle with Johnstone scoring after only 42 seconds, the quickest goal scored in the Cup final.

zh.s: 1976年苏格兰杯决赛于1976年5月1日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，是第91届苏格兰杯决赛。流浪者队对阵哈茨队，最终以3比1获胜。德里克·约翰斯通梅开二度，亚历克斯·麦克唐纳也为流浪者队进球；格雷厄姆·肖为哈茨队进球。流浪者队从开场起便占据优势，约翰斯通在第42秒破门，这是苏格兰杯决赛最快进球。

en.s: The 1976 FA Cup final was the 95th final of the FA Cup. It took place on 1 May 1976 at Wembley Stadium and was contested between Manchester United and Southampton. United had finished third in the First Division that season, and were strong favourites, while unfancied Southampton had finished sixth in the Second Division, Southampton had more players with FA Cup final experience than Manchester United, namely Jim McCalliog (1966), Peter Rodrigues (1969) and Peter Osgood (1970).

zh.s: 1976年英格兰足总杯决赛是第95届足总杯决赛，于1976年5月1日在温布利球场举行，由曼联对阵南安普敦。曼联当季在英格兰足球甲级联赛中排名第三，是夺冠热门；南安普敦则不被看好，当季在乙级联赛排名第六。南安普敦阵中有更多球员参加过足总杯决赛，包括吉姆·麦卡利奥格（1966年）、彼得·罗德里格斯（1969年）和彼得·奥斯古德（1970年）。

en.s: The 1977 FAI Cup final was the final match of the 1976–77 FAI Cup, a knock-out association football competition contested annually by clubs affiliated with the Football Association of Ireland. It took place on Sunday 1 May 1977 at Dalymount Park in Dublin, and was contested by Dundalk and Limerick. Dundalk won 2–0 to win the cup for the fifth time.

zh.s: 1977年爱尔兰足协杯决赛是1976—77赛季爱尔兰足协杯的决赛。这项淘汰赛每年举行，参赛俱乐部均隶属于爱尔兰足球协会。比赛于1977年5月1日星期日在都柏林达利蒙特公园举行，由邓多克对阵利默里克。邓多克以2比0获胜，第五次捧起杯赛冠军。

en.s: The 1978 Algerian Cup final was the 16th final of the Algerian Cup. The final took place on May 1, 1978, at Stade 5 Juillet 1962 in Algiers with kick-off at 20:00. CR Belcourt won over USK Alger on a penalty shootout after the teams were still tied, 0 to 0, following 30 minutes of extra time. In the shootout, Belcourt outscored Alger, 2 to 0.

zh.s: 1978年阿尔及利亚杯决赛是第16届阿尔及利亚杯决赛，于1978年5月1日20时在阿尔及尔的1962年7月5日体育场举行。常规时间和30分钟加时赛后，贝尔库特青年队与阿尔及尔联合队仍以0比0战平。点球大战中，贝尔库特青年队以2比0胜出。

en.t: City of Edinburgh District Council election, 1980
en.s: Elections for the City of Edinburgh District Council took place on 1 May 1980, alongside elections to the councils of Scotland's various other districts. The Conservatives, who had previously controlled a majority on the council, were reduced to being just shy of a majority. The Conservatives continued to rule the council however, with Liberal support. The election saw 4 new wards being added to Edinburgh; Fort, Shandon, Haymarket, and Tollcross. All, minus Tollcross, (which was won by the Conservatives) were won by Labour. Turnout was 160,330.

zh.s: 1980年5月1日，爱丁堡区议会举行选举，与苏格兰其他地区的地方议会选举同时进行。此前控制多数席位的保守党席位减少，未能过半，但在自由党支持下继续执政。爱丁堡新增了4个选区：福特、尚登、海马基特和托尔克罗斯。除保守党赢得的托尔克罗斯外，其余三个选区都由工党获胜。投票人数为160330人。

en.s: Elections to Leeds City Council were held on Thursday, 1 May 1980, with boundary changes prompting the entirety of the council to be elected. The boundary changes added an extra ward to the existing 32 - increasing the councillor total by three to 99 - with just half the ward names surviving the changes: The drop in Conservative support - which seen them set lows in vote share and seats won - allowed Labour to win record representation and comfortably regain control of the council from the Conservatives, with a 25-seat strong majority.

en.s: Local elections were held in the United Kingdom in 1980. These were the first annual local elections for the new Conservative Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher. Though the Conservatives in government lost seats, the projected share of the vote was close: Labour Party 42%, Conservative Party 40%, Liberal Party 13%. Labour were still being led by the former prime minister James Callaghan, who resigned later in the year to be succeeded by Michael Foot.

zh.s: 1980年，英国举行地方选举。这是玛格丽特·撒切尔出任保守党首相后的首次年度地方选举。执政的保守党虽然失去席位，但估算得票率与工党相近：工党42%，保守党40%，自由党13%。工党仍由前首相詹姆斯·卡拉汉领导，他于当年晚些时候辞职，由迈克尔·富特接任。

en.s: General elections were held in Cambodia on 1 May 1981 and marked the establishment of the new, Vietnamese-backed, state of the People's Republic of Kampuchea (PRK). The Kampuchean People's Revolutionary Party was the only party to contest the election, and won all 117 seats. Voter turnout was reported to be 97.8%. Pen Sovan, the General Secretary, became Prime Minister on 27 June 1981 but was removed from office on 5 December and replaced by Chan Sy.

zh.s: 1981年5月1日，柬埔寨举行大选，标志着越南支持的新国家柬埔寨人民共和国成立。柬埔寨人民革命党是唯一参选政党，赢得全部117个席位。投票率据报为97.8%。该党总书记彭索万于1981年6月27日出任总理，但在12月5日被免职，由陈西接任。

en.s: The 1982 WFA Cup Final was the 12th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was played under the auspices of the Women's Football Association (WFA). Lowestoft and Cleveland Spartans contested the match at Loftus Road in London on 1 May 1982. Lowestoft won 2–0.

zh.s: 1982年英格兰女子足总杯决赛是该项赛事的第12场决赛，也是英格兰女子足球的主要杯赛。女子足球协会主办的决赛由洛斯托夫特和克利夫兰斯巴达队对阵，于1982年5月1日在伦敦女王公园巡游者主场洛夫特斯路球场举行。洛斯托夫特以2比0获胜。

en.s: The 1982 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1981–82 DFB-Pokal, the 39th season of Germany's knockout football cup competition. It was played on 1 May 1982 at the Waldstadion in Frankfurt. Bayern Munich won the match 4–2 against 1. FC Nürnberg, to claim their 6th cup title. The Austrian Reinhold Hintermaier opened the scoring for underdogs Nürnberg after 30 minutes with a shot from about 40 meters away, before Werner Dreßel doubled Der Club's lead just prior to halftime.

zh.s: 1982年德国足协杯决赛决出了1981—82赛季德国足协杯冠军，这是德国淘汰制足球杯赛的第39个赛季。比赛于1982年5月1日在法兰克福瓦尔德球场举行，拜仁慕尼黑以4比2击败纽伦堡，赢得队史第六座德国杯冠军。比赛第30分钟，纽伦堡的奥地利球员赖因霍尔德·欣特迈尔在约40米外射门，帮助这支不被看好的球队首开纪录；半场结束前，维尔纳·德雷塞尔又扩大了纽伦堡的领先优势。

en.s: Operations Black Buck 1 to Black Buck 7 were seven extremely long-range airstrikes conducted during the 1982 Falklands War by Royal Air Force (RAF) Vulcan bombers of the RAF Waddington Wing, comprising aircraft from Nos. 44, 50 and 101 Squadrons, against Argentine positions in the Falkland Islands. Five of the missions completed attacks. The objective of the missions was to attack Port Stanley Airport and its associated defences.
en.n: Operation Black Buck: The Royal Air Force attacks the Argentine Air Force during the Falklands War.

zh.s: 黑雄鹿一号至七号行动是英国皇家空军在1982年福克兰群岛战争期间实施的七次超远程空袭，由瓦丁顿联队的火神式轰炸机执行，参战飞机来自第44、50和101中队。空袭针对阿根廷在福克兰群岛的阵地，其中五次完成了攻击任务。行动目标是袭击斯坦利港机场及其相关防御设施。
zh.n: 黑雄鹿行动：英国皇家空军在福克兰群岛战争期间空袭阿根廷空军。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 1 May 1986. One third of the council was up for election and the Labour Party kept overall control of the council.

en.s: The 1988 FAI Cup final was the final match of the 1987–88 FAI Cup, a knock-out association football competition contested annually by clubs affiliated with the Football Association of Ireland. It took place on Sunday 1 May 1988 at Dalymount Park in Dublin, and was contested by Dundalk and Derry City. Dundalk won the match 1–0 to win the cup for the eighth time, and, in so doing, won their second League and Cup Double.

zh.s: 1988年爱尔兰足协杯决赛是1987—88赛季爱尔兰足协杯的决赛。这项淘汰赛每年举行，参赛俱乐部均隶属于爱尔兰足球协会。比赛于1988年5月1日星期日在都柏林达利蒙特公园举行，由邓多克对阵德里城。邓多克以1比0获胜，第八次夺冠，并因此第二次实现联赛与杯赛双冠王。

en.s: The 1988 WFA Cup Final was the 18th final of the WFA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was played under the auspices of the Women's Football Association (WFA). Doncaster Belles and Leasowe Pacific contested the match on 1 May 1988 at Gresty Road, the home stadium of Crewe Alexandra. Doncaster ended up winning the game 3–1.

zh.s: 1988年女子足球协会杯决赛是该赛事第18届决赛。这项赛事是英格兰女子足球队的主要杯赛，由女子足球协会主办。比赛于1988年5月1日在克鲁亚历山德拉队主场格雷斯蒂路球场举行，对阵双方是唐卡斯特贝尔斯和利索太平洋队。最终唐卡斯特贝尔斯以3比1获胜。

en.s: Early general elections were held in Paraguay on 1 May 1989, following the overthrow of President Alfredo Stroessner on 3 February. For the first time in several years, the opposition was allowed to contest the elections more or less unmolested. The presidential elections were won by Andrés Rodríguez (who had led the coup) running on the Colorado Party ticket. The Colorado Party also won 48 of the 72 seats in the Chamber of Deputies. Voter turnout was 54% in the presidential election and 52% in the parliamentary elections.

zh.s: 1989年5月1日，巴拉圭提前举行大选。此前，阿尔弗雷多·斯特罗斯纳总统于2月3日被推翻。反对党多年来首次得以较自由地参加选举。发动政变的安德烈斯·罗德里格斯代表红党参选并赢得总统选举。红党还赢得众议院72席中的48席。总统选举投票率为54%，议会选举投票率为52%。

en.s: The National Union for the Total Independence of Angola (Portuguese: União Nacional para a Independência Total de Angola, abbr. UNITA) is the second-largest political party in Angola. Founded in 1966, UNITA fought alongside the People's Movement for the Liberation of Angola (MPLA) and the National Liberation Front of Angola (FNLA) in the Angolan War for Independence (1961–1975) and then against the MPLA in the ensuing civil war (1975–2002).

zh.t: 安哥拉内战：MPLA与UNITA达成比塞斯协定
zh.s: 安哥拉彻底独立全国联盟（葡萄牙语：União Nacional para a Independência Total de Angola，简称UNITA）是安哥拉第二大政党。该党成立于1966年，曾在安哥拉独立战争（1961—1975年）中与安哥拉人民解放运动（MPLA）和安哥拉民族解放阵线（FNLA）并肩作战，随后在安哥拉内战（1975—2002年）中与MPLA交战。

en.s: The attack on Cloghoge checkpoint was an unconventional bomb attack carried out on 1 May 1992 by the Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) against a British Army permanent vehicle checkpoint. The IRA's South Armagh Brigade fitted a van with wheels that allowed it to move along a railway line. A large bomb was placed inside the van, which was then driven along the railway line to the target. The compound, just north of the village of Cloghoge in County Armagh, was wrecked by the explosion.

zh.t: 克洛霍格检查站袭击事件
zh.s: 临时爱尔兰共和军于1992年5月1日对英国陆军一处永久车辆检查站发动了非传统炸弹袭击。临时爱尔兰共和军南阿马旅改装了一辆货车，使它能沿铁路轨道行驶，并在车内放置一枚大型炸弹，再沿铁轨将货车开向目标。爆炸摧毁了位于阿马郡克洛霍格村以北的检查站营地。

en.s: Ranasinghe Premadasa, the 3rd President of Sri Lanka, was assassinated on 1 May 1993, in the Sri Lankan capital of Colombo, during a May Day rally organized by the United National Party (UNP). Premadasa and 23 others were killed in a suicide bombing conducted by the LTTE. The explosion took place at around 12:45 PM at the junction of Armour Street and Grandpass Road in Hulftsdorp, Colombo.

zh.t: 拉纳辛哈·普雷马达萨遇刺
zh.s: 斯里兰卡第三任总统拉纳辛哈·普雷马达萨于1993年5月1日在首都科伦坡遇刺身亡。当时，他正在参加由统一国民党组织的五一集会。猛虎组织发动自杀式爆炸，普雷马达萨和另外23人遇难。爆炸于中午12时45分左右发生在科伦坡胡尔夫茨多普的阿莫街与格兰德帕斯路交叉口。

en.t: 1993 United States Senate special election in Texas
en.s: The 1993 United States Senate special election in Texas was held on June 6, 1993, to replace Democratic U.S. Senator Lloyd Bentsen, who had resigned to become Secretary of the Treasury. Krueger ran in the special election, but was defeated in a landslide by Republican Kay Bailey Hutchison.

en.s: The 1994 San Marino Grand Prix (formally the 14° Gran Premio di San Marino) was a Formula One motor race held on 1 May 1994 at the Autodromo Enzo e Dino Ferrari, located in Imola, Italy. It was the third race of the 1994 Formula One season. Tragic events at this race proved to be a major turning point in both the 1994 season, and in the development of Formula One itself, particularly with regard to safety. The race weekend was marked by the deaths of Austrian driver Roland Ratzenberger and of three-time world champion Ayrton Senna in separate accidents.

zh.s: 1994年圣马力诺大奖赛（正式名称：第14届圣马力诺大奖赛）是一级方程式赛车比赛，于1994年5月1日在意大利伊莫拉的恩佐与迪诺·法拉利赛道举行，是1994赛季第三场比赛。比赛周末发生的悲剧对1994赛季以及一级方程式赛车的发展产生重大影响，尤其推动了安全改革。奥地利车手罗兰·拉岑伯格和三届世界冠军艾尔顿·塞纳分别在事故中丧生。

en.s: The 1996 Bulgarian Cup final was played at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia on 1 May 1996, and was contested between the sides of Slavia Sofia and Levski Sofia. The Levski Sofia players were ordered off the field of play by the chairman Tomas Lafchis shortly after the 75' mark due to the latter's dissatisfaction with the refereeing.

zh.s: 1996年保加利亚杯决赛于1996年5月1日在索非亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行，对阵双方是索非亚斯拉维亚和索非亚列夫斯基。最终索非亚斯拉维亚获胜。比赛进行到第75分钟后不久，索非亚列夫斯基主席托马斯·拉夫奇斯因不满裁判判罚，命令球队球员离场。

en.s: The 1997 Nottinghamshire County Council election was held on Thursday, 1 May 1997. The whole council was up for election and the result was the Labour Party retaining its control of the council. This was the first County Council election not to include the City of Nottingham, which would become a unitary authority in 1998 and therefore no longer a part of the administrative county of Nottinghamshire. The boundaries of the electoral divisions remained the same however the loss of Nottingham meant that there were 25 fewer seats.

zh.s: 1997年5月1日星期四，诺丁汉郡举行郡议会选举，全体议席改选。工党保住了议会控制权。这是首次不包括诺丁汉市的郡议会选举；诺丁汉市于1998年成为单一制地方政府辖区，不再属于诺丁汉郡行政区。选区边界没有变化，但诺丁汉市不再参与后，席位减少了25个。

en.s: The United Kingdom general election of 1997 was held on 1 May 1997, five years after the previous election on 9 April 1992, to elect 659 members to the British House of Commons. Under the leadership of Tony Blair, the Labour Party ended its 18 years in opposition and won the general election with a landslide victory, winning 418 seats, the most seats the party has ever held. The election saw a huge 10.2% swing from the Conservatives to Labour on a national turnout of 71% and would be last national vote where turnout exceeded 70% until the 2016 EU Referendum was held nineteen years later.

zh.s: 1997年5月1日，英国举行大选，选出659名下议院议员，距离上次大选已过去五年。托尼·布莱尔领导的工党结束了长达18年的在野时期，以压倒性优势获胜，赢得418席，创下该党历史上席位数新高。保守党转向工党的全国得票率摆动达10.2个百分点，投票率为71%。直到19年后的2016年英国脱欧公投，英国才再次出现投票率超过70%的全国性投票。

zh.s: 1997年斯劳自治市议会选举于5月1日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举和英国大选同日进行。斯劳自治市议会全部41个席位改选，而非通常的三分之一席位。

en.s: The 1997 Reading Borough Council election was held on 1 May 1997, at the same time as other local elections across England, and on the same day as the general election. All of the 45 seats on Reading Borough Council were up for election, rather than the usual third of the seats.

zh.s: 1997年雷丁自治市议会选举于5月1日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举和英国大选同日进行。雷丁自治市议会全部45个席位改选，而非通常的三分之一席位。

en.s: The 1997 Bracknell Forest Borough Council election took place on 1 May 1997, to elect all 40 members in 19 wards for Bracknell Forest Borough Council in England. The election was held on the same day as both the 1997 United Kingdom general election and other local elections in England as part of the 1997 United Kingdom local elections, resulting in a much higher turnout of 75% compared to 1995.

zh.t: 1997年布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1997年5月1日，英格兰布拉克内尔森林自治市议会举行选举，改选19个选区的全部40名议员。选举与1997年英国大选和英格兰其他地方选举同日举行，投票率为75%，远高于1995年。

en.s: The 1997 Thurrock Council election took place on 1 May 1997 to elect the members of Thurrock Council in Essex, England. It took place on the same day as the 1997 general election and other local elections across England.

zh.s: 1997年5月1日，英格兰埃塞克斯郡瑟罗克议会举行选举。选举与1997年大选和英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。

en.t: 1997 United Kingdom general election in Northern Ireland
en.s: On 1 May 1997, the 1997 United Kingdom general election was held in Northern Ireland, to elect all 659 members of the House of Commons, including the 18 Northern Ireland seats. This was an increase of one seat in Northern Ireland, where the House of Commons as a whole had increased from 650 to 659 seats. 1,177,969 people were eligible to vote, up 53,069 from the 1992 general election.

zh.s: 1997年5月1日，北爱尔兰举行英国大选，选出下议院全部659名议员，其中包括北爱尔兰的18个席位。北爱尔兰席位增加1席，下议院总席位也从650席增加至659席。共有1177969人具备投票资格，比1992年大选增加53069人。

en.s: The 1997 United Kingdom local elections took place on Thursday 1 May 1997 in England, and Wednesday 21 May 1997 in Northern Ireland. Elections took place for all of the English country councils, some English unitary authorities and all of the Northern Ireland districts. The local elections were held on the same day as the 1997 general election.

zh.s: 1997年英国地方选举于5月1日星期四在英格兰举行，5月21日星期三在北爱尔兰举行。英格兰所有郡议会、部分单一制地方政府辖区，以及北爱尔兰所有区议会均举行选举。地方选举与1997年英国大选同日举行。

en.s: The 1997 Norfolk County Council election took place on 1 May 1997, coinciding with local elections for county councils in England and the 1997 general election.

zh.s: 1997年5月1日，诺福克郡举行郡议会选举，与英格兰各郡地方选举和英国大选同日进行。

en.s: The 1997 Plymouth City Council election took place on 1 May 1997 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it had held since 1991.

zh.s: 1997年5月1日，英格兰德文郡普利茅斯市举行市议会选举，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党保住了议会控制权，该党自1991年以来一直执政。

en.t: 1997 United Kingdom general election in England
en.s: On Thursday 1 May 1997, the 1997 United Kingdom general election was held in England, to elect all 659 members of the House of Commons, with 529 constituencies being in England. Under Tony Blair, the Labour Party won a landslide majority of English seats, the first time since 1966 that Labour had won an overall majority of English seats.

zh.s: 1997年5月1日星期四，英格兰举行英国大选，选出下议院全部659名议员，其中529个选区位于英格兰。托尼·布莱尔领导的工党在英格兰赢得压倒性多数。这是自1966年以来，工党首次在英格兰赢得议席多数。

en.t: 1997 United Kingdom general election in Wales
en.s: On Thursday 1 May 1997, the 1997 United Kingdom general election was held in Wales, to elect all 659 members of the House of Commons, with 40 constituencies being in Wales. The Labour Party won a landslide majority of Welsh MPs, gaining seven seats for a total of 34 out of 40. The Liberal Democrats gained one seat, whilst Plaid Cymru retained their four MPs.

zh.s: 1997年5月1日星期四，威尔士举行英国大选，选出下议院全部659名议员，其中40个选区位于威尔士。工党以压倒性优势赢得威尔士议席，增加7席后共获34席。自由民主党增加1席，威尔士党保住4席。

en.s: The 1997 Suffolk County Council election took place on 1 May 1997 to elect members of Suffolk County Council in Suffolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections and the 1997 general election.

zh.s: 1997年5月1日，英格兰萨福克郡举行郡议会选举，选出萨福克郡郡议会议员。选举与其他地方选举和英国大选同日举行。

en.s: The 1997 Essex County Council election took place on 1 May 1997 to elect members of Essex County Council in Essex, England. This was held on the same day as other local elections and the 1997 general election. 79 councillors were elected from various electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 1997年5月1日，英格兰埃塞克斯郡举行郡议会选举，选出埃塞克斯郡郡议会议员。选举与其他地方选举和英国大选同日举行。共选出79名议员，各选区采用简单多数制选出一至两名郡议员，任期四年。

en.s: Elections to Cumbria County Council were held on 1 May 1997. This was on the same day as other UK county council elections. The Labour Party gained control of the council, which had been under no overall control.

zh.s: 坎布里亚郡郡议会于1997年5月1日举行选举，与英国其他郡议会选举同日进行。工党从没有任何政党占多数的局面中夺得议会控制权。

en.t: 1997 United Kingdom general election in Scotland
en.s: A general election was held in the United Kingdom on 1 May 1997 and all 72 seats in Scotland were contested. This would be the last UK general election to be contested in Scotland before the Scottish Parliament was established on 1 July 1999 following overwhelming public approval in a referendum.

zh.s: 英国于1997年5月1日举行大选，苏格兰的72个席位全部改选。这是苏格兰议会成立前最后一次英国大选。1999年7月1日全民公投获得压倒性支持后，苏格兰议会正式成立。

en.s: The 1997 Southend-on-Sea Borough Council election took place on 1 May 1997 to elect members of Southend-on-Sea Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as the 1997 general election and other local elections. This was the first election to the council following its establishment as a unitary authority, with the council taking on the powers and responsibilities of Essex County Council for the area.

zh.s: 1997年5月1日，英格兰埃塞克斯郡绍森德举行自治市议会选举，选出议会议员。选举与英国大选和其他地方选举同日举行。这是绍森德成为单一制地方政府辖区后举行的首场选举，议会接管了埃塞克斯郡议会在当地的职权和责任。

en.s: Tatton in the 1997 general election was one of the UK's highest-profile constituencies. In what was previously one of the safest Conservative seats in the country, Independent candidate, Martin Bell managed to take the seat from the sitting Conservative MP, Neil Hamilton.

zh.s: 1997年英国大选中的塔顿选区备受关注。这个选区此前是全国最稳固的保守党席位之一，但独立候选人马丁·贝尔击败在任保守党议员尼尔·汉密尔顿，赢得该席位。

en.t: Enfield Southgate in the 1997 general election
en.s: The constituency of Enfield Southgate returned a memorable result in the 1997 United Kingdom general election, when the seat's incumbent Member of Parliament, the Conservatives' Michael Portillo, lost to Labour's Stephen Twigg. The result came as a shock to many politicians and commentators, and came to symbolise the extent of the Labour landslide victory under the leadership of Tony Blair.

zh.t: 1997年大选中的恩菲尔德南盖特选区
zh.s: 1997年英国大选中，恩菲尔德南盖特选区出现了令人难忘的结果：在任保守党议员迈克尔·波蒂略败给工党候选人斯蒂芬·特威格。这一结果令许多政界人士和评论员震惊，也成为托尼·布莱尔领导下工党压倒性胜利的标志之一。

en.s: The 1997 Cornwall County Council election, was an election for all 79 seats on the council. Cornwall County Council was a county council that covered the majority of the ceremonial county of Cornwall, with the exception of the Isles of Scilly which had an independent local authority. The elections took place concurrently with other local elections across England and Northern Ireland.

zh.s: 1997年康沃尔郡议会选举改选议会全部79个席位。康沃尔郡议会的管辖范围覆盖康沃尔礼仪郡的大部分地区，不包括拥有独立地方政府的锡利群岛。选举与英格兰和北爱尔兰其他地方选举同期举行。

en.t: The Labour Party wins the 1997 General Election and Tony Blair is elected as Prime Minister
en.s: Sir Anthony Charles Lynton Blair (born 6 May 1953) is a British politician who served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1997 to 2007 and Leader of the Labour Party from 1994 to 2007. He was Leader of the Opposition from 1994 to 1997, held shadow cabinet posts from 1987 to 1994, and was Member of Parliament (MP) for Sedgefield from 1983 to 2007.

zh.t: 工党赢得1997年大选，托尼·布莱尔当选首相
zh.s: 安东尼·查尔斯·林顿·布莱尔爵士（生于1953年5月6日）是英国政治人物，1997年至2007年任英国首相，1994年至2007年任工党领袖。他于1994年至1997年担任反对党领袖，1987年至1994年担任影子内阁职务，并于1983年至2007年任塞奇菲尔德选区议员。

en.s: The 2000 FA Women's Cup Final was the 30th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the seventh final to be held under the direct control of the Football Association (FA). The match was contested by Doncaster Belles and Croydon Women at Bramall Lane in Sheffield on 1 May 2000.

zh.s: 2000年英格兰女子足总杯决赛是第30届决赛，也是英格兰女子足球队的主要杯赛之一。这是英格兰足球总会首次直接负责举办的第七届决赛。比赛于2000年5月1日在谢菲尔德布拉莫巷球场举行，对阵双方是唐卡斯特贝尔斯和克罗伊登女队。

en.s: Elections to Manchester Council were held on Thursday, 1 May 2003. One third of the council was up for election as well as a vacancy in Benchill, with each successful candidate to serve a one-year term of office, expiring in 2004, due to the boundary changes and 'all-out' elections due to take place in that year. Turnout was down slightly to 22.2%, with Labour retaining overall control of the council. The election saw the Greens winning their first seat, and half a dozen Liberal Democrat gains resulting in Labour's majority being the lowest in twenty years.

zh.s: 2003年5月1日星期四，曼彻斯特举行市议会选举，改选三分之一议席和本奇尔选区的一个空缺席位。由于边界调整和2004年全体改选安排，当选者任期为一年。投票率略降至22.2%，工党保住了议会控制权。绿党首次赢得席位，自由民主党也赢得六个席位，使工党多数席位降至20年来最低。

en.s: Local elections took place in various parts of the United Kingdom on 1 May 2003, the same day as the Scottish Parliamentary and the Welsh Assembly elections. There were local elections for all councils in Scotland and in most of England. There were no elections in Wales, Northern Ireland or London. The ruling Labour Party lost a considerable 833 seats, while both the main opposition parties, Conservative and Liberal Democrat, polled strongly, with the Conservatives enjoying the largest share of the vote. Labour had now been in government for six years and still had a triple-digit majority, and over the summer of 2003 some opinion polls showed the Tories level with Labour.

zh.s: 2003年5月1日，英国多个地区举行地方选举，与苏格兰议会和威尔士国民议会选举在同一天进行。苏格兰各地以及英格兰大部分地区都举行地方选举，威尔士、北爱尔兰和伦敦则没有选举。执政工党失去833个席位，主要反对党保守党和自由民主党表现强劲，其中保守党得票占比最高。工党已执政六年，仍拥有三位数多数席位；2003年夏季的一些民调显示，保守党支持率已追平工党。

en.s: The 2003 elections to Argyll and Bute Council were held on the 1 May 2003 and were the third for the unitary authority, which was created under the Local Government etc (Scotland) Act 1994 and replaced the previous two-tier system of local government under Strathclyde Regional Council and Dumbarton and Argyll & Bute District Councils. It was held on the same day as the second Scottish Parliament election and resulted in no change to the administration of the council - independent control. These were the last elections to the council using the first past the post electoral system.

zh.s: 阿盖尔-比特议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，是1994年《地方政府法》设立这一单一制地方政府辖区后的第三次选举。该法取代了此前由斯特拉斯克莱德区域议会、邓巴顿区议会和阿盖尔-比特区议会组成的两级地方政府体系。选举与第二次苏格兰议会选举同日举行，议会管理方式仍为无党派人士控制。这是最后一次采用简单多数制举行的议会选举。

en.s: The 2003 Bristol City Council election took place on 1 May 2003, on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party made a number of losses, mainly to the Liberal Democrats, and lost overall control of the council. Loses included Council leader Diane Bunyan, who lost her Windmill Hill seat to the Liberal Democrats. This year also saw elections contested by the new Bristolian Party, founded by the local 'scandle sheet' The Bristolian, though they failed to win any seats.

zh.s: 2003年布里斯托市议会选举于5月1日举行，与其他地方选举在同一天进行。工党失去了一些席位，主要被自由民主党夺走，并失去议会多数控制权。工党议会领袖黛安·邦扬也失去风车山选区席位，败给自由民主党。新成立的布里斯托人党也参加了选举，但未赢得席位；该党由当地“丑闻小报”《布里斯托人报》创立。

en.s: The Scottish Parliament election, 2003, was the second election of members to the Scottish Parliament. It was held on 1 May 2003 and it brought no change in terms of control of the Scottish Executive. Jack McConnell, the Labour Party Member of the Scottish Parliament (MSP), remained in office as First Minister and the Executive continued as a Labour and Liberal Democrat coalition. The results also showed rises in support for "minor parties" including the Scottish Green Party and the Scottish Socialist Party (SSP) and declines in support for the Labour Party and the Scottish National Party (SNP).

zh.s: 2003年苏格兰议会选举于5月1日举行，是第二次苏格兰议会选举。选举没有改变苏格兰行政院的执政格局。工党议员杰克·麦康奈尔继续担任首席部长，行政院仍由工党和自由民主党联合执政。绿党、苏格兰社会党等小党支持率上升，工党和苏格兰民族党支持率下降。

en.s: The National Assembly for Wales election, 2003 was the second general election to the National Assembly for Wales. It was held on 1 May 2003.The election was characterised by a resurgence for the Labour Party, whilst Plaid Cymru saw a reduction in support and the number of Assembly Members they returned. Having won thirty seats Labour chose to govern without a coalition partner. This election also saw the returning of John Marek as an independent member of the Assembly. For lists of constituencies and regions, see National Assembly for Wales constituencies and electoral regions.

zh.s: 2003年威尔士国民议会选举是该议会的第二次大选，于2003年5月1日举行。工党支持率回升，威尔士党支持率和议员人数则下降。工党赢得30席后，选择单独执政。独立议员约翰·马雷克也再次当选。

en.s: The 2003 Sheffield Council election took place on 1 May 2003 to elect members of Sheffield City Council. One third of the council was up for election and the Labour took control of the council from no overall control with six gains from the Liberal Democrats. The election saw a trial of electronic voting in half of the council's wards. Voters in these wards were able to vote by either text message, touch tone phone, internet, post, or use electronic kiosks as well as the normal polling stations.

zh.s: 2003年5月1日，谢菲尔德举行市议会选举，选出议会成员。议会三分之一席位改选，工党从没有任何党派占多数的状态中夺回控制权，从自由民主党手中赢得六席。部分选区试行电子投票，选民可通过短信、按键电话、互联网、邮寄、电子投票亭或普通投票站投票。

en.s: The 2003 Worthing Borough Council election took place on 1 May 2003 to elect members of Worthing Borough Council in West Sussex, England. The election saw 38 candidates from 4 parties competing for the 13 seats which were being contested. 7 sitting councillors stood down at the election which saw the Liberal Democrats attempting to defend the majority they had won in the previous election in 2002.

en.s: The 2003 Slough Borough Council election was held on 1 May 2003, at the same time as other local elections across England and Scotland. Fourteen of the 41 seats on Slough Borough Council were up for election, being the usual third of the council.

zh.s: 2003年5月1日，英格兰和苏格兰举行地方选举，斯劳自治市议会同期举行选举。斯劳自治市议会41个席位中有14席改选，通常每次会改选三分之一席位。

en.s: The 2003 Borough Council of Wellingborough election took place on 1 May 2003 to elect members of Borough Council of Wellingborough in Northamptonshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2003年韦灵伯勒自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2003年5月1日，英格兰北安普敦郡韦灵伯勒举行自治市议会选举，选出自治市议会成员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: Elections to South Hams District Council took place on 1 May 2003, the same day as other United Kingdom local elections. The whole council was up for election and the Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 南哈姆斯区议会于2003年5月1日举行选举，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。全体席位改选，保守党保住了议会控制权。

en.s: The 2003 Plymouth City Council election was held on 1 May 2003 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in England. This was on the same day as the other local elections. The election was the first to be contested under new ward boundaries, and as a result the entire council was up for election.

zh.s: 2003年5月1日，英格兰普利茅斯市举行市议会选举，选出议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。这是采用新选区边界举行的首次选举，因此全体席位改选。

en.s: Elections to Mid Bedfordshire District Council were held on 1 May 2003. All 53 seats were up for election. Councillors elected would serve a four-year term, expiring in 2007. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council, winning 37 of 53 seats on the council. The Conservatives won 7 seats (5 wards) unopposed.

zh.t: 2003年中贝德福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 中贝德福德郡区议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，全部53个席位均进行改选。当选议员任期四年，于2007年届满。保守党继续掌控议会，赢得53席中的37席。保守党有7名候选人在5个选区未经竞争便当选。

en.s: On 1 May 2003, an election was held to elect councillors to the North Warwickshire Borough Council in the English Midlands. It took place on the same day as other local elections in the UK. It was the first election to take place under the new ward boundaries, with one extra seat from the previous 34 seats added.

zh.t: 2003年北沃里克郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 北沃里克郡自治市议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。此次选举首次采用新的选区边界，在原有34个席位基础上增加一席。

en.s: Elections to Northampton Borough Council were held on 1 May 2003. The whole council was up for election and the Labour Party lost overall control of the council to no overall control.

zh.t: 2003年北安普敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 北安普敦自治市议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，议会全部席位改选。工党失去对议会的绝对控制，选举后没有任何政党占多数。

en.s: Elections to Hyndburn Borough Council were held on 1 May 2003. One third of the council was up for election and the Conservative party gained overall control of the council from the Labour party. Overall turnout was 51.5%.

zh.s: 欣德本自治市议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，议会三分之一席位改选。保守党从工党手中夺得议会控制权。总体投票率为51.5%。

en.s: Elections to Portsmouth City Council were held on 1 May 2003. One-third of the council seats were up for election, and the council remained under no overall control. Overall turnout was 26.6%.

zh.s: 朴茨茅斯市议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，议会三分之一席位改选。选举后，议会仍没有任何政党占多数。总体投票率为26.6%。

en.s: Elections to Inverclyde Council were held on 1 May 2003, the same day as other Scottish Local Government elections and the Scottish Parliament Election.

zh.s: 因弗克莱德议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举及苏格兰议会选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2003 Dundee City Council election was held on 1 May 2003, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections and the Scottish Parliament general election.

zh.s: 邓迪市议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举及苏格兰议会大选同日进行。

en.s: Elections to West Lothian Council were held on 1 May 2003, on the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. This was the third election to the unitary council following the implementation of the Local Government etc. (Scotland) Act 1994. The election used the 32 wards created by the Third Statutory Reviews of Electoral Arrangements in 1998. Each ward elected one councillor using first-past-the-post voting.

zh.s: 西洛锡安议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。这是1994年《苏格兰地方政府等法》实施后，该单一制议会举行的第三次选举。此次选举采用1998年第三次法定选区审查划定的32个选区，每个选区选出一名议员，采用简单多数制。

en.s: Elections to the Shetland Islands Council were held on 1 May 2003 as part of Scottish local elections. The Liberal Democrats were reduced to 5 seats, with independent candidates making gains. Eight seats were uncontested.

zh.s: 设得兰群岛议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，是苏格兰地方选举的一部分。自由民主党席位减至5席，独立候选人有所斩获。另有8个席位未经竞争便产生当选者。

en.t: 2003 Bath and North East Somerset Council election
en.s: Elections were held on 1 May 2003 to elect 65 local councillors for Bath and North East Somerset Council. The results are shown below. Following the election, a coalition was formed between the Liberal Democrats and Conservative councillors. Cllr Paul Crossley became leader of the council.

zh.t: 2003年巴斯和东北萨默塞特议会选举
zh.s: 2003年5月1日举行选举，选出巴斯和东北萨默塞特议会65名地方议员。选举后，自由民主党议员与保守党议员组成联合政府，保罗·克罗斯利议员出任议会领袖。

en.s: The 2003 Perth and Kinross Council election was held on 1 May 2003, the same day as other Scottish Local Government elections and the Scottish Parliament Election. This was the last election using 41 single member wards, in which the Scottish National Party won the most seats with 15.

zh.s: 2003年珀斯和金罗斯议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举及苏格兰议会选举同日进行。这是最后一次采用41个单一议员选区的选举，苏格兰民族党以15席成为赢得席位最多的政党。

en.s: Elections to the Orkney Islands Council were held on 1 May 2003 as part of Scottish local elections. Only independent candidates contested the election. Nine seats were uncontested.

zh.s: 奥克尼群岛议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，是苏格兰地方选举的一部分。参选者均为独立候选人，另有9个席位未经竞争便产生当选者。

en.s: The 2003 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 1 May 2003, at the same time as other local elections across England and Scotland. 16 of the 49 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council were up for election, being the usual third of the council.

zh.t: 2003年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2003年北赫特福德郡区议会选举于5月1日举行，与英格兰和苏格兰其他地方选举同期进行。北赫特福德郡区议会49个席位中有16席进行改选，约占议会三分之一。

en.s: The 2003 East Lothian Council election was held on 1 May 2003, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections and the Scottish Parliament general election.

zh.s: 东洛锡安议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举及苏格兰议会大选同日进行。

en.s: The 2003 Test Valley Borough Council election took place on the 1 May 2003. With new ward boundaries, all 48 seats were up for election. 25 seats were needed for a majority, with the Conservatives winning 30; the Liberal Democrats won 16 seats, and Independents won 2.

zh.t: 2003年泰斯特谷自治市议会选举
zh.s: 泰斯特谷自治市议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，全部48个席位按新的选区边界改选。取得多数需要25席，保守党赢得30席，自由民主党赢得16席，独立人士赢得2席。

en.s: Elections to West Wiltshire District Council were held on 1 May 2003. The whole council was up for election and the Liberal Democrats lost their majority, leaving the council with no overall control. Many wards had boundary changes, and some were new. None were uncontested.

zh.s: 西威尔特郡区议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，议会全部席位改选。自由民主党失去多数席位，选举后议会没有任何政党占多数。许多选区边界有所调整，也新设了一些选区；所有席位均有人竞争。

en.s: The 2003 Stirling Council election was held on 1 May 2003, the same day as the other Scottish local government elections.

zh.s: 斯特灵议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2003 West Dunbartonshire Council election were held on the 1 May 2003 and were the third to the unitary authority, which was created along with 28 other local authorities, under the Local Government etc (Scotland) Act 1994. They were also the last held under the single-member constituency first past the post system.

zh.s: 西邓巴顿郡议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，是1994年《苏格兰地方政府等法》设立该单一制地方政府后举行的第三次选举。该法同时设立了另外28个地方政府。这也是最后一次采用单一议员选区和简单多数制的选举。

en.s: Elections to Daventry District Council were held on 1 May 2003. One third of the council was up for election and the Conservative Party stayed in overall control of the council. Overall turnout was 34%.

zh.s: 达文特里区议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，议会三分之一席位改选。保守党继续掌控议会。总体投票率为34%。

en.s: The 2003 East Renfrewshire Council election for the East Renfrewshire Council took place on 1 May 2003, alongside elections to Scotland's various other councils.

zh.s: 东伦弗鲁郡议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，与苏格兰其他议会选举同期进行。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 1 May 2003. One third of the council was up for election plus one by-election, and the Liberal Democrat party kept overall control of the council. Overall turnout was 21.7%.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，议会三分之一席位改选，此外还举行了一场补选。自由民主党继续掌控议会。总体投票率为21.7%。

en.s: Elections to Moray Council were held on 1 May 2003, on the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. This was the third election to the unitary council following the implementation of the Local Government etc. (Scotland) Act 1994. The election used the 26 wards created by the Third Statutory Reviews of Electoral Arrangements in 1998. Each ward elected one councillor using first-past-the-post voting.

zh.s: 马里议会选举于2003年5月1日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。这是1994年《苏格兰地方政府等法》实施后，该单一制议会举行的第三次选举。此次选举采用1998年第三次法定选区审查划定的26个选区，每个选区选出一名议员，采用简单多数制。

en.t: 2003 Brighton and Hove City Council election
en.s: Elections to Brighton and Hove City Council on the south coast of England were held on 1 May 2003. The whole council (a unitary authority) was up for election and all 54 councillors were elected from 21 wards. Labour lost their majority on the council but continued to govern in a minority administration.

zh.t: 2003年布莱顿和霍夫市议会选举
zh.s: 英格兰南海岸的布莱顿和霍夫市议会选举于2003年5月1日举行。作为单一制地方政府，议会全部54个席位均进行改选，由21个选区选出议员。工党失去议会多数席位，但仍以少数派政府形式继续执政。

en.s: Elections to City of York Council were held in 2003. The whole council was up for election. Boundary changes had reduced the number of seats from 53 to 47.

zh.s: 约克市议会选举于2003年举行，议会全部席位改选。选区边界调整后，席位数从53个减至47个。

en.s: The First Battle of Fallujah, code-named Operation Vigilant Resolve, was an American-led operation of the Iraq War against militants in Fallujah as well as an attempt to apprehend or kill the perpetrators of the killing of four U.S. contractors in March 2004. The chief catalyst for the operation was the highly publicized killing and mutilation of four Blackwater USA private military contractors, and the killings of five American soldiers in Habbaniyah a few days earlier.

en.t: Cyprus, Czech Republic, Estonia, Hungary, Latvia, Lithuania, Malta, Poland, Slovakia, and Slovenia join the European Union, celebrated at the residence of the Irish President in Dublin
en.s: The Czech Republic, also known as Czechia and historically known as Bohemia, is a landlocked country in Central Europe. The country is bordered by Austria to the south, Germany to the west, Poland to the northeast, and Slovakia to the southeast. The Czech Republic has a hilly landscape that covers an area of 78,871 square kilometers (30,452 sq mi) with a mostly temperate continental and oceanic climate.

zh.t: 塞浦路斯、捷克等十国加入欧盟
zh.s: 捷克共和国（又称捷克，历史上称波希米亚）是中欧内陆国家，南邻奥地利，西接德国，东北与波兰接壤，东南与斯洛伐克接壤。国土多丘陵，面积78,871平方公里（30,452平方英里），气候以温带大陆性和海洋性气候为主。

en.t: Entry into force of Road Traffic Safety Law of the People's Republic of China
en.s: The Road Traffic Safety Law of the People's Republic of China (Chinese: 中华人民共和国道路交通安全法) is a law which was passed by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress of the People's Republic of China on October 28, 2003, promulgated by Decree No. 8 of the President of the PRC Hu Jintao, and took effect on May 1, 2004, on all parts of mainland China (but not in Hong Kong and Macau which have their own judicial systems.)

zh.t: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》施行
zh.s: 《中华人民共和国道路交通安全法》由全国人民代表大会常务委员会于2003年10月28日通过，并由中华人民共和国主席胡锦涛以第8号主席令公布。该法于2004年5月1日起在中国大陆施行；香港和澳门有各自的司法制度，不适用该法。

en.s: Backlash (2005) was the seventh annual Backlash professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE), which took place on May 1, 2005, at the Verizon Wireless Arena in Manchester, New Hampshire. It was presented by Namco's Tekken 5. The show's six matches showcased prominent WWE wrestlers, who acted out the franchise's stories in and out of the ring. The event starred talent from the Raw brand. To date, it is the only WWE pay-per-view event ever to be held in the state of New Hampshire. In the main event, Batista defeated Triple H in a singles match to retain the World Heavyweight Championship.

zh.s: 2005年《Backlash》是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）举办的第七场《Backlash》按次付费赛事，于2005年5月1日在新罕布什尔州曼彻斯特的维里孙无线竞技场举行，由南梦宫《铁拳5》赞助。六场比赛由WWE知名摔角手参赛，在线上和擂台内演绎赛事故事，参赛选手来自Raw品牌。这是WWE唯一一场在新罕布什尔州举办的按次付费赛事。主赛中，巴蒂斯塔击败三重H，保住世界重量级冠军头衔。

en.t: Hong Kong Election Committee Subsector by-elections, 2005
en.s: The 2005 Election Committee Subsector By-elections were held on 1 May 2005 to fill the 33 vacancies in 17 subsectors of the Election Committee for electing the Hong Kong Chief Executive in the Chief Executive election in following March.

zh.t: 2005年香港选举委员会界别分组选举
zh.s: 2005年选举委员会界别分组选举于2005年5月1日举行，填补选举委员会17个界别分组的33个空缺。选举委员会将在次年3月的行政长官选举中选出香港行政长官。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 1 May 2005. The three seats up for election were Murchison, held by independent MLC Tony Fletcher; Paterson, held by independent MLC Don Wing; and Rumney, held by Labor MLC Lin Thorp. Paterson was last contested in 2000, while Murchison and Rumney were last contested in 1999.

zh.t: 2005年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举于2005年5月1日举行，改选三个席位：独立议员托尼·弗莱彻代表的默奇森选区、独立议员唐·温代表的帕特森选区，以及工党议员林·索普代表的朗姆尼选区。帕特森选区上次选举在2000年举行，默奇森和朗姆尼选区则于1999年上次改选。

en.s: The 2006 FA Women's Cup Final was the 36th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the 13th final to be held under the direct control of the Football Association (FA). The final was contested between Arsenal and Leeds United on 1 May 2006 at The Den in New Cross, London. Leeds United made its first final appearance.

zh.s: 2006年英格兰女子足总杯决赛是该项赛事的第36场决赛，也是由英格兰足球总会直接管理后举行的第13场决赛。阿森纳女队与利兹联女队于2006年5月1日在伦敦纽克罗斯的米尔沃尔主场丹球场交锋。利兹联女队首次闯入决赛。

en.s: The 2007 Denver mayoral election was held on May 1, 2007. Since John Hickenlooper obtained an absolute majority of the vote in the initial round of voting, no runoff was held.

zh.s: 2007年丹佛市长选举于2007年5月1日举行。约翰·希肯卢珀在首轮投票中获得绝对多数，因此没有举行决选。

en.t: Cheshire West and Chester Council election, 2008
en.s: Elections to the newly created Cheshire West and Chester Council took place on 1 May 2008. Elections occurred in all 24 wards, with each ward returning 3 councillors to the council. The wards are identical to the former Cheshire County Council wards. From May 2008 until April 2009, the elected members formed a "shadow" council, which made preparations for the changeover from the county and borough structure to the new unitary authority structure. Thereafter, the members will serve for two years from May 2009. The next elections were held in May 2011.

zh.t: 2008年柴郡西部和切斯特市议会选举
zh.s: 新设的柴郡西部和切斯特市议会于2008年5月1日举行选举。24个选区全部改选，每个选区选出3名议员。新选区与原柴郡郡议会选区相同。2008年5月至2009年4月，当选议员组成“过渡议会”，为县和自治市架构改组为新的单一制地方政府作准备。之后议员将从2009年5月起任职两年。下次选举于2011年举行。

en.s: Elections to Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council were held on 1 May 2008. One third of the council was up for election and the council stayed under no overall control. On 9 May, about a week after being elected as a Liberal Democrat, Greetland and Stainland Councillor Keith Watson left the Liberal Democrats and joined the Conservative Party. In 2009 the Skircoat Councillor Geoffrey Wainwright died suddenly. A by-election was held on 2nd April 2009. The seat was held by the Conservative Party with John Hardy winning the seat.

zh.s: 卡尔德代尔市议会选举于2008年5月1日举行，议会三分之一席位改选，选后仍没有任何政党占多数。自由民主党议员基思·沃森在5月9日当选后不久退出自由民主党，加入保守党。2009年，斯基尔科特选区议员杰弗里·温赖特突然去世，于是2009年4月2日举行补选。保守党候选人约翰·哈迪赢得该席位。

en.s: Elections to Manchester City Council took place on 1 May 2008. One third of the council was up for election - every ward of the city returned one councillor at this election out of the three councillors a ward in the city has. Four national political parties - the Conservative Party, Labour, Liberal Democrats and the Green Party - each stood a candidate in every ward in this election. There were candidates from other political parties standing in some of the wards, but there were no independent candidates standing for election this year in the city.

en.s: The 2008 United Kingdom local elections were held on 1 May 2008. These elections took place in 137 English Local Authorities and all Welsh Councils. There were also extraordinary elections held for four of the new unitary authorities being created, in Northumberland, County Durham and Cheshire (two councils - Cheshire East and Cheshire West and Chester). Scheduled elections for Penwith in Cornwall, Shrewsbury & Atcham in Shropshire, Bedford and South Bedfordshire in Bedfordshire and five district councils in Cheshire were cancelled, due to the up-coming unitary authorities being established in those counties.

en.s: Elections to Gosport Council in Hampshire, England were held on 1 May 2008. Half of the council was up for election and the council stayed under no overall control. Before the election the Labour and Liberal Democrat parties had held power on the council with the casting vote of the mayor. The election saw the Liberal Democrats close the gap with the Conservative party after making 5 gains, while the Labour party lost four of the five seats they had held. However following the election the Conservative party said that they would take charge of the council as they remained the largest party.

en.s: Elections for Ipswich Borough Council were held on Thursday 1 May 2008. One third of the seats were up for election. The Labour Party won enough seats to become the largest party gaining 3 seats (2 from Con 1 from Lib Dem). The Conservatives had been the largest party since the Ipswich Council election 2006. The results came as a stark contrast which saw the Conservatives make significant gains from Labour across the country. Particular disappointments for the Conservatives came when they lost Rushmere and Bridge to Labour and narrowly failed to gain St Margaret's from the Liberal Democrats, while narrowly holding onto St John's by a mere 3 votes.
