zh.s: 2008年北赫特福德郡议会选举于5月1日举行，与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同日进行。北赫特福德郡区议会49个席位中有15席改选。仅有两个席位易主，保守党均从工党手中赢得席位，因此扩大了议会多数；该党领袖F. John Smith继续担任议会领袖。工党的得票率虽有所上升，席位数却被自由民主党反超，后者成为议会第二大党。选前工党由戴维·卡恩斯领导，选后由马丁·斯蒂尔斯接任。

en.s: The 2008 London mayoral election for the office of Mayor of London, England, was held on 1 May 2008. Conservative candidate Boris Johnson defeated incumbent Labour Mayor Ken Livingstone. It was the third London mayoral election, the previous elections being the first election in May 2000 and the second election in June 2004. Johnson became the second Mayor of London and the first Conservative to hold the office since its creation in 2000.

zh.s: 英格兰伦敦市长选举于2008年5月1日举行。保守党候选人鲍里斯·约翰逊击败工党现任市长肯·利文斯通。这是伦敦第三次市长选举，此前两次分别于2000年5月和2004年6月举行。约翰逊成为伦敦第二任市长，也是该职位2000年设立以来首位保守党籍市长。

en.s: The 2008 Danish Cup final was the final and deciding match of the 2007–08 Danish Cup. It took place on Thursday, 1 May 2008 at Parken Stadium in Copenhagen. Brøndby IF, the Superliga number 9 of the day, met the then number 8 Esbjerg fB. Brøndby had won the Cup on five previous occasions (1989, 1994, 1998, 2003, and 2005), while Esbjerg took the trophy in 1964 and 1976, but lost the final in 2006 to Randers FC.

zh.s: 2008年丹麦杯决赛决出了2007—08赛季丹麦杯冠军。比赛于2008年5月1日星期四在哥本哈根公园球场举行。布隆德比队当时在丹麦超级联赛排名第九，对阵排名第八的埃斯比约队。布隆德比此前五次夺得丹麦杯冠军，分别是在1989、1994、1998、2003和2005年；埃斯比约曾于1964年和1976年夺冠，但在2006年决赛中输给兰讷斯。

en.s: Elections to Hyndburn Borough Council were held on 1 May 2008. One third of the council was up for election and the Conservative Party stayed in overall control of the council. Overall turnout was 37.9%. The Conservative Party made the only gain of the election, taking Altham ward from the Labour Party to extend their majority to 6 following the defection of Malcolm Pritchard form Labour to Independent who also included David Mason who had left the Conservatives to go Independent..

zh.s: 欣德本自治市议会选举于2008年5月1日举行，议会三分之一席位改选。保守党继续掌控议会。总体投票率为37.9%。本次选举中只有保守党赢得其他政党控制的席位：该党从工党手中夺得阿尔瑟姆选区。马尔科姆·普里查德脱离工党成为独立人士，戴维·梅森也脱离保守党成为独立人士；此后，保守党在议会中的多数席位扩大到6席。

en.s: An election to the London Assembly took place on 1 May 2008, along with the 2008 London mayoral election. The Conservatives gained 2 seats, Labour gained one seat, the Liberal Democrats lost two seats, and UKIP were wiped out. Notably, a candidate for the British National Party (BNP) was elected for the first time. The Assembly is elected by the Additional Member System.

zh.s: 伦敦议会选举于2008年5月1日与伦敦市长选举同期举行。保守党增加2席，工党增加1席，自由民主党失去2席，英国独立党则失去全部席位。值得注意的是，英国国家党候选人首次当选。议会采用附加成员制选举。

en.s: The 2008 Cardiff Council election was held on 1 May, along with the 2008 Welsh local elections. All 75 seats of Cardiff Council were contested, with it remaining in no overall control.

zh.s: 加的夫议会选举于2008年5月1日举行，与2008年威尔士地方选举同期进行。加的夫议会全部75个席位均进行改选，选举后仍没有任何政党占多数。

en.s: The 2008 Reading Borough Council election to the Reading Borough Council resulted in gains for the Conservatives and the Liberal Democrats and losses for the Labour Party. The Labour leader of the council, David Sutton, lost his seat in the election.

zh.s: 2008年雷丁自治市议会选举后，保守党和自由民主党增加席位，工党失去席位。工党籍议会领袖戴维·萨顿在选举中失去席位。

en.t: The bridge was opened to public May 1, 2008, after a considerable period of testing and evaluation
en.s: Hangzhou Bay Bridge (simplified Chinese: 杭州湾大桥; traditional Chinese: 杭州灣大橋; pinyin: Hángzhōu Wān Dàqiáo; Wu: Han-tseu-uae du-jiau) is a long 35.7 km (22.2 mi) highway bridge with two separate cable-stayed portions, built across the mouth of Hangzhou Bay in the eastern coastal region of China. It connects the municipalities of Jiaxing and Ningbo in Zhejiang province.

zh.t: 杭州湾大桥向公众开放
zh.s: 杭州湾大桥（简体中文：杭州湾大桥；繁体中文：杭州灣大橋；拼音：Hángzhōu Wān Dàqiáo；吴语：Han-tseu-uae du-jiau，字面意为“杭州湾大桥”）是一座长35.7公里（22.2英里）的公路桥，横跨中国东部沿海的杭州湾湾口，桥上有两段彼此分开的斜拉桥。它连接浙江省嘉兴市和宁波市。

en.s: On 1 May 2008, at approximately 09:02 HKT, a tour bus flipped onto its side on Hiram's Highway in Sai Kung District, New Territories. The crash killed 19 people and injured 43. The incident was Hong Kong's third deadliest road traffic accident, behind a 2018 incident killing 19 and injuring 61, and a 2003 incident which killed 21.

zh.s: 2008年5月1日香港时间约9时02分，一辆旅游巴士在新界西贡区西贡公路翻侧。事故造成19人死亡、43人受伤，是香港死亡人数第三多的道路交通事故；此前，2018年和2003年的两起事故分别造成19人死亡、61人受伤和21人死亡。

en.s: The attack on Bari Alai, also called the Battle of Nishagam, was an attack by Taliban insurgents on the International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) Observation Post (OP) Bari Alai in the perimeter of Nishagam in Kunar Province, Afghanistan, that took place on 1 May 2009. The attack was successful in being the first time during the War in Afghanistan that the Taliban had completely overrun a coalition outpost.

zh.s: 巴里阿莱袭击又称尼沙加姆战役，是塔利班武装分子对阿富汗库纳尔省尼沙加姆周边国际安全援助部队（ISAF）巴里阿莱观察哨发动的袭击，发生于2009年5月1日。塔利班在这次行动中首次完全攻占联军前哨。

en.s: On May 1, 2010, a terrorist attack was attempted in Times Square in Manhattan, New York, United States. Two street vendors alerted NYPD officers after they spotted smoke coming from a vehicle, and a car bomb was discovered. The bomb had been ignited, but failed to explode, and was disarmed before it caused any casualties.

zh.t: 2010年时代广场汽车炸弹未遂案
zh.s: 2010年5月1日，美国纽约市曼哈顿时代广场发生一起未遂恐怖袭击。两名街头摊贩发现一辆汽车冒烟后通知纽约市警察局，警方随后发现车内有炸弹。炸弹已被点燃，但没有爆炸；警方在其造成人员伤亡前将其拆除。

en.s: The 2010 Welsh Cup final was the final of the 124th season of the main domestic football cup competition in Wales, the Welsh Cup. The final was played at Parc y Scarlets in Llanelli on 1 May 2010 and marked the second time the final has been staged at the stadium. The match was contested by Port Talbot Town, who beat Bala Town 1–0 in their semi-final, and Bangor City who beat Prestatyn Town 2–0 in their semi-final.

zh.s: 2010年威尔士杯决赛是威尔士主要国内足球杯赛——威尔士杯第124个赛季的决赛。比赛于2010年5月1日在拉内利的斯卡利特公园球场举行，这是决赛第二次在该球场举办。参赛双方是波特塔尔伯特镇和班戈城：前者在半决赛中以1比0击败巴拉镇，后者以2比0击败普雷斯坦丁镇。

en.s: The 2010 Coupe Gambardella final was the 55th final of France's youth cup competition. The final took place on 1 May 2010 at the Stade de France in the Parisian suburb of Saint-Denis and served as a curtain raiser for the final of the Coupe de France. The match was contested between Sochaux and Metz. The final was shown live on France 4.

zh.s: 2010年甘巴德拉杯决赛是法国青年杯赛第55届决赛。比赛于2010年5月1日在巴黎郊区圣但尼的法兰西体育场举行，为法国杯决赛揭幕。参赛双方是索肖和梅斯，法国4台对比赛进行了现场直播。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 1 May 2010. The two seats up for election were Apsley, held by independent MLC Tania Rattray, and Elwick, held by retiring Labor-turned-independent MLC Terry Martin. These seats were last contested in 2004.

zh.t: 2010年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举于2010年5月1日举行，改选两个席位：独立议员塔妮娅·拉特雷代表的阿普斯利选区，以及即将退休的工党转独立议员特里·马丁代表的埃尔威克选区。这两个席位上次改选是在2004年。

en.s: The 2010 Coupe de France final was the 92nd final of France's most prestigious cup competition. The final took place on 1 May 2010 at the Stade de France in the Parisian suburb of Saint-Denis. The cup was won by Paris Saint-Germain with a 1–0 win against Monaco. A Guillaume Hoarau header in extra time was the difference between the teams.

zh.s: 2010年法国杯决赛是法国最重要的杯赛第92届决赛。比赛于2010年5月1日在巴黎郊区圣但尼的法兰西体育场举行。巴黎圣日耳曼以1比0击败摩纳哥，夺得冠军。加时赛中，纪尧姆·奥阿罗头球破门，决定了比赛胜负。

en.s: The 2011 Algerian Cup final was the final of the 47th edition of the Algerian Cup. The game was held on May 1, 2011 at the Stade 5 Juillet 1962 in Algiers between USM El Harrach and JS Kabylie. JS Kabylie won the game 1–0 with a goal from Farès Hamiti in the 13th minute of the game. It was JS Kabylie's fifth time winning the Algerian Cup.

zh.s: 2011年阿尔及利亚杯决赛是第47届阿尔及利亚杯决赛，于2011年5月1日在阿尔及尔的1962年7月5日体育场举行，由哈拉奇联合队对阵卡比利青年队。卡比利青年队凭法雷斯·哈米蒂第13分钟的进球，以1比0获胜，第五次夺得阿尔及利亚杯。

en.s: The 2011 Extreme Rules was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE. It was the third annual Extreme Rules event and took place on May 1, 2011, at the St. Pete Times Forum in Tampa, Florida, held for wrestlers from the promotion's Raw and SmackDown brand divisions. The theme of the event was that it featured various hardcore-based matches.

zh.s: 2011年Extreme Rules是WWE制作的一场职业摔角按次付费赛事，也是该赛事第三年举办。比赛于2011年5月1日在佛罗里达州坦帕的圣彼得时报论坛举行，参赛者来自WWE的Raw和SmackDown两个品牌。赛事主题是举行多场硬核风格比赛。

en.t: Pope John Paul II is beatified by his successor, Pope Benedict XVI
en.s: Pope Benedict XVI (born Joseph Alois Ratzinger; 16 April 1927 – 31 December 2022) was the head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of Vatican City from 2005 until his resignation in 2013. Following his resignation, he chose to be known as "pope emeritus", a title he held until his death on 31 December 2022.

zh.t: 教宗若望·保禄二世宣福礼由继任者本笃十六世主持
zh.s: 本笃十六世（本名约瑟夫·阿洛伊斯·拉青格；1927年4月16日—2022年12月31日）自2005年至2013年辞职前担任天主教会领袖和梵蒂冈城国君主。辞职后，他选择使用“荣休教宗”这一称号，并一直使用至2022年12月31日去世。

en.s: Between April 30 and May 1, 2012, Malian soldiers of the 33rd Parachute Commando Regiment, colloquially known as the Red Berets, attempted a counter-coup against the Green Berets of the Malian National Guard and Gendarmerie which had overthrown Amadou Toumani Touré and installed Amadou Sanogo in a coup a month prior.

zh.s: 2012年4月30日至5月1日，马里第33伞兵突击团的士兵（俗称“红色贝雷帽”）试图对抗马里国民卫队和宪兵队中的“绿色贝雷帽”。后者一个月前推翻了阿马杜·图马尼·杜尔，并通过政变扶植阿马杜·萨诺戈上台。

en.s: The 2012 Algerian Cup final was final of the 48th edition of the Algerian Cup. The game was held on May 1, 2012, at the Stade 5 Juillet 1962 in Algiers between CR Belouizdad and ES Sétif. ES Sétif won the game 2–1 in extra-time with a goal from Mokhtar Benmoussa in the 96th minute. FIFA president Sepp Blatter and CAF president Issa Hayatou were both there in attendance.

zh.s: 2012年阿尔及利亚杯决赛是第48届阿尔及利亚杯决赛，于2012年5月1日在阿尔及尔的1962年7月5日体育场举行，由贝鲁伊兹达德俱乐部对阵塞蒂夫体育俱乐部。塞蒂夫体育俱乐部在加时赛中以2比1获胜，莫赫塔尔·本穆萨在第96分钟打入制胜球。国际足联主席塞普·布拉特和非洲足联主席伊萨·哈亚图均到场观赛。

en.s: The 2014 Slovnaft Cup final was the final match of the 2013–14 Slovak Cup, the 45th season of the top cup competition in Slovak football. The match was played at the Stadium Myjava in Myjava on 1 May 2014 between ŠK Slovan Bratislava and MFK Košice. MFK Košice defeated Slovan Bratislava 2-1.

zh.s: 2014年Slovnaft杯决赛是2013—14赛季斯洛伐克杯的决赛，也是斯洛伐克足球顶级杯赛的第45个赛季。比赛于2014年5月1日在米亚瓦体育场举行，由布拉迪斯拉发斯洛万对阵科希策MFK队。科希策MFK以2比1获胜。

zh.s: 2015年斯洛伐克杯决赛（因赞助原因称Slovnaft杯决赛）是2014—15赛季斯洛伐克杯的决赛，也是斯洛伐克足球顶级杯赛的第46个赛季。比赛于2015年5月1日在波普拉德的NTC波普拉德球场举行，由特伦钦队对阵塞尼察队。特伦钦队在点球大战后以3比2击败塞尼察队。

en.s: The 2016 A-League Grand Final was the eleventh A-League Grand Final, and was played on 1 May 2016, at Adelaide Oval to determine the 2015–16 A-League Champion. The match was contested by the two winning finals series semi-finalists, Adelaide United and Western Sydney Wanderers who finished the 2015–16 A-League season in first and second position respectively. The match was won by Adelaide United, who defeated Western Sydney Wanderers 3–1 in front of a crowd of 50,119. The Grand Final was both teams' third, with both never having won. Adelaide losing the 2007 and 2009 grand finals against Melbourne Victory 6–0 and 1–0 respectively.

zh.s: 2016年澳大利亚A联赛总决赛是该赛事第11场总决赛，于2016年5月1日在阿德莱德椭圆球场举行，决出2015至2016赛季冠军。两支半决赛获胜球队阿德莱德联和西悉尼流浪者对阵，常规赛排名分别为第一和第二。阿德莱德联以3比1获胜，现场观众为50119人。这是两队第三次闯入总决赛，此前均未夺冠。阿德莱德联曾在2007年和2009年两次输给墨尔本胜利，比分分别为0比6和0比1。

en.s: The 2016 Payback was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It was the fourth annual Payback and took place on May 1, 2016, at the Allstate Arena in the Chicago suburb of Rosemont, Illinois. The event is considered by WWE to be the first PPV and livestreaming event of The New Era. The concept of the event was based around wrestlers seeking payback against their opponents.

zh.s: 2016年Payback是WWE制作的一场职业摔角按次付费及网络直播赛事，也是该赛事第四年举办。比赛于2016年5月1日在伊利诺伊州罗斯蒙特的奥尔斯泰特体育馆举行，该地位于芝加哥郊区。WWE将其视为“新时代”的首场按次付费及网络直播赛事。赛事主题是摔角手向对手寻求报复。

zh.s: 2016年阿尔及利亚杯决赛是第52届阿尔及利亚杯决赛，于2016年5月1日16时在阿尔及尔的1962年7月5日体育场举行。

en.s: The 2017 Slovak Cup final (known as the Slovnaft Cup for sponsorship reasons) was the final match of the 2016–17 Slovak Cup, the 48th season of the top cup competition in Slovak football. The match was played at the NTC Poprad in Poprad on 1 May 2017 between MFK Skalica and ŠK Slovan Bratislava.

zh.s: 2017年斯洛伐克杯决赛（因赞助原因称Slovnaft杯决赛）是2016—17赛季斯洛伐克杯的决赛，也是斯洛伐克足球顶级杯赛的第48个赛季。比赛于2017年5月1日在波普拉德的NTC波普拉德球场举行，由斯卡利察MFK队对阵布拉迪斯拉发斯洛万队。

en.s: The 2018 Sioux Falls mayoral election took place on May 1, 2018, following a primary election on April 10, 2018. Incumbent Mayor Mike Huether was term-limited and could not run for a third consecutive term. Businessman Paul TenHaken, the founder of a local digital marketing firm, placed first in the primary, winning 34 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2018年苏福尔斯市长选举于5月1日举行，初选则于同年4月10日举行。时任市长迈克·休瑟任期届满，不能竞选连续第三个任期。当地数字营销公司创办人保罗·滕哈肯在初选中排名第一，获得34%的选票。

en.s: The 2018 Algerian Cup final was the 54th final of the Algerian Cup. The final took place on May 1, 2018, at Stade 5 Juillet 1962 in Algiers with kick-off at 16:00.

zh.s: 2018年阿尔及利亚杯决赛是第54届阿尔及利亚杯决赛，于2018年5月1日16时在阿尔及尔的1962年7月5日体育场举行。

en.s: The 2018 Slovak Cup final (known as the Slovnaft Cup for sponsorship reasons) was the final match of the 2017–18 Slovak Cup, the 49th season of the top cup competition in Slovak football. The match was played at the Anton Malatinský Stadium in Trnava on 1 May 2018 between ŠK Slovan Bratislava and MFK Ružomberok.

zh.s: 2018年斯洛伐克杯决赛（因赞助原因称Slovnaft杯决赛）是2017—18赛季斯洛伐克杯的决赛，也是斯洛伐克足球顶级杯赛的第49个赛季。比赛于2018年5月1日在特尔纳瓦的安东·马拉廷斯基球场举行，由布拉迪斯拉发斯洛万对阵鲁容贝罗克。

en.s: The 2018–2019 Bangladesh drug war or 2018–2019 Bangladesh's war on drugs was a campaign against alleged drug dealers and users by the government of Bangladesh under Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. The extrajudicial killings of alleged drug dealers by the elite anti-crime unit Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) and the police have been criticized by various human rights groups and foreign diplomats.

zh.s: 2018—2019年孟加拉国禁毒战争是谢赫·哈西娜领导的孟加拉国政府针对涉嫌贩毒者和吸毒者开展的一场行动。快速行动营和警方杀害涉嫌贩毒者的行为遭到多个国际人权组织和外国外交官批评。

en.s: On 1 May 2019, a landmine killed 15 Indian police and their driver in Gadchiroli, state of Maharashtra, India. Police have blamed the blast on Maoists because they are common in the area. The attack took place after Maoist set 25 vehicles on fire.

zh.t: 加德奇罗利纳萨尔派地雷爆炸案
zh.s: 2019年5月1日，印度马哈拉施特拉邦加德奇罗利发生地雷爆炸，造成15名印度警察和司机死亡。警方将爆炸归咎于毛派，因为当地毛派活动频繁。袭击发生前，毛派人员烧毁了25辆汽车。

en.s: The 2019 Belgian Cup final, named Croky Cup after the sponsor, was the 64th Belgian Cup final and took place on 1 May 2019 between Gent and KV Mechelen. KV Mechelen was the first team from outside the top division to qualify for the cup final since the 2001 Belgian Cup Final when Belgian Second Division champions Lommel lost to Westerlo.

zh.s: 2019年比利时杯决赛因赞助商而称为Croky杯决赛，是第64届比利时杯决赛，于2019年5月1日举行，由根特对阵梅赫伦。梅赫伦是自2001年比利时杯决赛以来，首支闯入决赛的非顶级联赛球队；2001年时，乙级联赛冠军洛默尔曾在决赛中输给韦斯特洛。

en.s: The 2019 Austrian Cup final was played on 1 May 2019 between FC Red Bull Salzburg and SK Rapid Wien at Wörthersee Stadion, Klagenfurt, a neutral ground. The final was the culmination of the 2018–19 Austrian Cup, the 88th season of the Austrian Cup.

zh.s: 2019年奥地利杯决赛于2019年5月1日举行，由萨尔茨堡红牛对阵维也纳快速，比赛场地是位于克拉根福的沃尔特湖球场，为中立场地。这场决赛是2018—19赛季奥地利杯的收官战，也是该赛事第88个赛季。

en.s: The 2019 Slovak Cup final (Slovak: Slovenský Pohár), known as the Slovnaft Cup for sponsorship reasons, was the final match of the 2018–19 Slovak Cup, the 50th season of the top cup competition in Slovak football. The match was played at the Štadión pod Zoborom in Nitra on 1 May 2019 between Spartak Trnava and Žilina.

zh.s: 2019年斯洛伐克杯决赛（斯洛伐克语：Slovenský Pohár，因赞助原因称Slovnaft杯决赛）是2018—19赛季斯洛伐克杯的决赛，也是斯洛伐克足球顶级杯赛的第50个赛季。比赛于2019年5月1日在尼特拉的佐博尔山下体育场举行，由特尔纳瓦斯巴达克对阵日利纳。

en.s: Naruhito (born 23 February 1960) is Emperor of Japan. He acceded to the Chrysanthemum Throne on 1 May 2019 following the abdication of his father, Akihito. He is the 126th monarch, according to the traditional order of succession. His reign is known as the Reiwa era. Naruhito is the elder son of Emperor Emeritus Akihito and Empress Emerita Michiko. He was born during the reign of his paternal grandfather, Hirohito.

zh.s: 德仁（1960年2月23日出生）是日本天皇。他的父亲明仁退位后，德仁于2019年5月1日继承菊花王座，成为日本第126代天皇，按传统纪年即位后的年号为令和。德仁是上皇明仁和上皇后美智子的长子，出生于祖父裕仁在位期间。

en.s: Operation Free Bafut was a week-long Cameroonian military operation against the Seven Karta militia in and around Bafut that resulted in the deaths of two separatist generals.

en.s: The 2021 Texas's 6th congressional district special election was held on May 1, 2021. The seat became vacant after incumbent Republican Ron Wright died on February 7 of COVID-19. Ron Wright's widow, Susan Wright from Arlington, who was endorsed by former president Donald Trump, and Jake Ellzey (who lost the Republican primary for this seat to Ron Wright in 2018) of Waxahachie, who served as a member of the Texas House of Representatives starting on January 12, advanced to the runoff.

zh.t: 2021年得克萨斯州第六国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 2021年得克萨斯州第六国会选区特别选举于2021年5月1日举行。共和党籍在任众议员罗恩·赖特于2月7日因新冠肺炎去世，留下空缺。罗恩·赖特的遗孀、来自阿灵顿并获前总统唐纳德·特朗普背书的苏珊·赖特，以及来自瓦克萨哈奇的杰克·埃尔泽进入决选。埃尔泽曾在2018年该选区共和党初选中败给罗恩·赖特，并于2021年1月12日起担任得克萨斯州众议员。

en.s: The 2021 Rey de Reyes (Spanish for "2021 King of Kings") was a professional wrestling tournament and supercard event produced by the Mexican Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA) promotion. It was held on May 1, 2021, in San Pedro Cholula, Puebla, Mexico at an unannounced location. The event was originally scheduled to be held at the Poliforum Zamna in Merida, Yucatan on March 21, 2020.

zh.s: 2021年Rey de Reyes（西班牙语意为“众王之王”）是墨西哥职业摔角联盟AAA全球摔角推广的锦标赛及大型赛事，于2021年5月1日举行，地点为墨西哥普埃布拉州圣佩德罗乔卢拉的一处未公开场馆。赛事原定于2020年3月21日在尤卡坦州梅里达的Zamna综合馆举行。

en.s: The 2021 Plano municipal elections took place on May 1, 2021. In addition to the mayoral election (Place 6), seats were contested for Places 2, 4, and 8, as well as a special election for Place 7. No candidate received a majority of the total vote in Places 2 and 7, so the two top vote-earners advanced to a runoff election.

zh.s: 2021年普莱诺市选举于2021年5月1日举行。除市长选举（第6席位）外，第2、第4和第8席位也进行选举，第7席位则举行特别选举。第2和第7席位的选举中，没有候选人获得总票数过半，因此得票最多的两名候选人进入决选。

en.s: The 2021 Dallas City Council election determined all 14 city council members in Dallas, Texas. The election occurred on May 1, 2021. By law, Dallas municipal elections are nonpartisan. In races where no candidate took a majority of over 50% of the total vote, the two top vote-earners advanced to a runoff election. Due to term limits, council members are limited to serving four consecutive terms (eight years).

zh.s: 2021年达拉斯市议会选举决定达拉斯市全部14名市议员的人选，选举于2021年5月1日举行。根据法律，达拉斯市选举不设党派标签。若某场选举中没有候选人获得超过50%的总票数，得票最多的两名候选人将进入决选。受任期限制，市议员最多可连续任职四届（八年）。

en.s: On May 1, 2021, at least sixteen Nigerien soldiers were killed in an ambush in Intoussan, Tillabéri Region, Niger by the Islamic State in the Greater Sahara. Nigerien officials reported the ambush as initially being located in Tillia, Tahoua Region, although footage from the attack posted by ISGS later showed the ambush occurring in Intoussan.

zh.s: 2021年5月1日，至少16名尼日尔士兵在尼日尔蒂拉贝里大区因图桑遭到大撒哈拉伊斯兰国伏击身亡。尼日尔官员最初称伏击发生在塔瓦大区蒂利亚，但该组织后来发布的袭击影像显示，地点是因图桑。

en.t: UFC on ESPN: Reyes vs. Procházka
en.s: UFC on ESPN: Reyes vs. Procházka (also known as UFC on ESPN 23 and UFC Vegas 25) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on May 1, 2021 at the UFC Apex facility in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Metropolitan Area, United States.

zh.t: UFC ESPN赛事：雷耶斯对阵普罗哈兹卡
zh.s: UFC ESPN赛事：雷耶斯对阵普罗哈兹卡（也称UFC ESPN 23或UFC Vegas 25）是终极格斗冠军赛举办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2021年5月1日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex场馆举行，该地属于拉斯维加斯都会区。

en.s: The 2021 Tasmanian state election was held on 1 May 2021 to elect all 25 members to the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The incumbent Liberal government, led by Premier of Tasmania Peter Gutwein, won a third term in government, winning 13 out of 25 seats. The Labor Party, led by the Opposition Leader Rebecca White was defeated, losing one seat won at the previous election in Clark to Glenorchy mayor Kristie Johnston, who ran as an independent, winning 11%.

zh.s: 2021年塔斯马尼亚州选举于2021年5月1日举行，选出塔斯马尼亚州众议院全部25名议员。彼得·古特温领导的自由党现任政府赢得第三个任期，取得25席中的13席。反对党领袖丽贝卡·怀特领导的工党落败，比上届少一席；该席由以独立候选人身份参选的格伦诺基市长克里斯蒂·约翰斯顿赢得，她获得11%的选票。

en.s: The 2021 Fort Worth mayoral election was held on Saturday, May 1, 2021, to decide the mayor of Fort Worth, Texas. Incumbent mayor Betsy Price, who had served as the city's mayor since 2011, announced on January 6, 2021, that she would not seek a sixth term. Ten candidates ran in the primary election. Early voting in person began on April 19, 2021.

zh.s: 2021年沃思堡市长选举于2021年5月1日星期六举行，选出得克萨斯州沃思堡市长。自2011年起担任市长的现任市长贝齐·普莱斯于2021年1月6日宣布不再竞选第六个任期。共有10名候选人参加初选，现场提前投票于2021年4月19日开始。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 1 May 2021. The three seats that were up for election are Derwent, Mersey and Windermere. They were last contested in 2015. Only two of the three seats were actually contested, as the incumbent candidate for Mersey, Mike Gaffney, was returned unopposed. The periodic elections coincided with the snap general election for the House of Assembly.

zh.t: 2021年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举于2021年5月1日举行，改选德文特、默西和温德米尔三个席位。这些席位上次改选是在2015年。实际只有两个席位进行竞争，因为默西选区现任议员迈克·加夫尼未经竞争便连任。此次定期选举与众议院提前大选同时举行。

en.s: The 2021 San Antonio mayoral election was held on May 1, 2021 to decide the mayor of San Antonio, Texas. The election was a nonpartisan blanket primary election. The incumbent mayor Ron Nirenberg won a third two-year term.

zh.s: 2021年圣安东尼奥市长选举于2021年5月1日举行，选出得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥市长。选举采用不分党派的全体选民初选制。现任市长罗恩·尼伦伯格赢得第三个两年任期。

en.s: A three-day border conflict between Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan began on 28 April 2021. The clashes stemmed from a long-running dispute over a water supply facility near the village of Kök-Tash. Tajikistani media raised some concern over military drills in Batken prior to the conflict.

zh.t: 2021年吉尔吉斯斯坦—塔吉克斯坦边境冲突
zh.s: 吉尔吉斯斯坦和塔吉克斯坦之间的边境冲突于2021年4月28日爆发，持续三天。冲突源于双方长期争议的一处供水设施，地点在科克塔什村附近。冲突爆发前，塔吉克媒体曾对巴特肯地区的军事演习表示担忧。

en.s: Wrestling Dontaku 2022 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW). It was held on May 1, 2022, in Fukuoka, at the Fukuoka PayPay Dome, marking the first time that Wrestling Dontaku was held at the venue since 2001.

zh.s: 2022年摔角Dontaku大赛是新日本职业摔角联盟举办的一场职业摔角赛事，于2022年5月1日在福冈PayPay巨蛋举行。这是自2001年以来，摔角Dontaku赛事首次在该场馆举办。

en.s: The 2021 Norwegian Football Cup final was the final match of the 2021 Norwegian Football Cup, the 115th season of the Norwegian Football Cup, the premier Norwegian football cup competition organized by the Norwegian Football Federation (NFF). The match was played on 1 May 2022 at the Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo, and opposed two Eliteserien sides, Bodø/Glimt and Molde.

zh.s: 2021年挪威足球杯决赛是2021年挪威足球杯的决赛，也是由挪威足球协会主办的挪威顶级足球杯赛第115个赛季的收官战。比赛于2022年5月1日在奥斯陆乌勒瓦尔球场举行，对阵双方是两支挪威足球超级联赛球队博德闪耀和莫尔德。

en.s: The Sinjar clashes of 2022 were a conflict that began on May 1, when the Iraqi military, with support from Turkey and the Kurdistan Democratic Party, launched an operation to push the YBS militia of the Popular Mobilization Forces out of Sinjar. After YBS rejected an Iraqi army request to evacuate a checkpoint in the area, the clashes began, and the main part of the clashes continued for an hour and injured two civilians, and displaced over 3,000.

zh.s: 2022年辛贾尔冲突于5月1日爆发。伊拉克军队在土耳其和库尔德斯坦民主党的支持下，发起行动，试图将人民动员力量中的YBS民兵赶出辛贾尔。YBS拒绝伊拉克军方撤离当地检查站的要求后，冲突爆发。主要战斗持续约一小时，造成两名平民受伤，逾3,000人流离失所。

en.s: The 2023 Slovak Cup final (known as the Slovnaft Cup for sponsorship reasons) was the final match of the 2022–23 Slovak Cup, the 54th season of the top cup competition in Slovak football. It was played at the Anton Malatinský Stadium in Trnava, Slovakia, on 1 May 2023. It was contested by the defending champions Spartak Trnava and Slovan Bratislava.

zh.s: 2023年斯洛伐克杯决赛（因赞助原因称Slovnaft杯决赛）是2022—23赛季斯洛伐克杯的决赛，也是斯洛伐克足球顶级杯赛的第54个赛季。比赛于2023年5月1日在斯洛伐克特尔纳瓦的安东·马拉廷斯基球场举行，由卫冕冠军特尔纳瓦斯巴达克对阵布拉迪斯拉发斯洛万。

en.s: The 2023 Sapporo Mayoral Election was held on 1 May 2023 as part of the 2023 Japanese unified local elections to elect the mayor of Sapporo. Incumbent Katsuhiro Akimoto won with a 56% majority. A major issue of the election included Sapporo's bid to host the 2030 Winter Olympics. Akimoto was a firm supporter of holding the olympic games in the city.

zh.s: 札幌市长选举于2023年5月1日举行，是2023年日本统一地方选举的一部分。现任市长秋元克广以56%的得票率胜出。选举中的一个重要议题是札幌申办2030年冬季奥运会，秋元克广坚决支持在札幌举办奥运会。

en.s: The 2024 Slovak Cup final (known as the Slovnaft Cup for sponsorship reasons) was the final match of the 2023–24 Slovak Cup, the 55th season of the top cup competition in Slovak football. The match was played on 1 May 2024, contested by MFK Ružomberok and FC Spartak Trnava.

zh.s: 2024年斯洛伐克杯决赛（因赞助原因也称Slovnaft杯决赛）是2023—24赛季斯洛伐克杯的决赛，也是斯洛伐克足球顶级杯赛的第55个赛季。比赛于2024年5月1日举行，由鲁容贝罗克和特尔纳瓦斯巴达克对阵。

en.s: The 2024 Svenska Cupen final was played on 1 May 2024 between Malmö FF and Djurgårdens IF at Eleda Stadion, Malmö, the home ground of Malmö FF, determined in a draw on 24 March 2024 after the semi-finals. The final was the culmination of the 2023–24 Svenska Cupen, the 68th season of Svenska Cupen and the twelfth season with the current format.

zh.s: 2024年瑞典杯决赛于2024年5月1日举行，由马尔默队对阵尤尔格丹队，比赛场地是马尔默队主场埃莱达球场。半决赛结束后，双方于2024年3月24日通过抽签确定决赛场地。此次决赛是2023—24赛季瑞典杯的收官战，也是瑞典杯第68个赛季、采用现行赛制后的第12个赛季。

en.s: The 2025 Leicestershire County Council election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect members to Leicestershire County Council in Leicestershire, England. All 55 seats were up for election. This was on the same day as other local elections. Prior to the election the council was under Conservative majority control.

zh.s: 2025年莱斯特郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出英格兰莱斯特郡议会议员。全部55个席位均进行改选，选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。选举前，议会由保守党以多数席位执政。

en.s: The 2025 Oxfordshire County Council election was held on 1 May 2025 to elect members to Oxfordshire County Council in Oxfordshire, England. All 69 seats were elected. This was on the same day as a by-election for the Oxford City Council ward of Headington Hill and Northway, as well as other local elections nationwide.

zh.s: 2025年牛津郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出英格兰牛津郡议会议员，全部69个席位均进行改选。当天还举行了牛津市议会海丁顿山与诺斯韦区的补选，以及英国各地其他地方选举。

en.s: The 2025 Hertfordshire County Council election was held on 1 May 2025 to elect members to Hertfordshire County Council in Hertfordshire, England. 78 councillors, one from each ward, were elected using the first-past-the-post voting system. This was on the same day as other local elections. Hertfordshire was one of 14 county councils to hold elections in 2025, after the government delayed several local elections to 2026 as part of a plan to reorganise local government.

zh.s: 2025年赫特福德郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行。每个选区选出一名议员，共选出78名议员，采用简单多数制。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。赫特福德郡是2025年举行选举的14个郡议会之一；此前，政府以重组地方政府为由，将若干地方选举推迟至2026年。

en.s: The 2025 Worcestershire County Council election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect members to Worcestershire County Council in Worcestershire, England as part of the 2025 UK local elections. All 57 seats were elected. The council was under Conservative majority control prior to the election. The election resulted in no overall control, with Reform UK emerging as the largest party and forming a minority administration led by Jo Monk.

zh.s: 2025年伍斯特郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，是英国2025年地方选举的一部分。全部57个席位均进行改选。选举前，议会由保守党以多数席位执政。选举后，议会没有任何政党取得绝对多数；改革英国党成为最大党，并组建了由乔·蒙克领导的少数派政府。

en.s: The 2025 Exeter City Council by-elections took place on 1 May 2025 to elect members of vacant seats in Exeter City Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. There were 2 of 39 seats on the council up for election. Labour and Reform gained seats.

zh.s: 2025年埃克塞特市议会补选于2025年5月1日举行，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会空缺席位的议员。当天还举行了其他地方选举。议会39个席位中有2席进行补选，工党和改革英国党各赢得一个席位。

en.s: The 2025 North Northamptonshire Council election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect members to 68 seats on North Northamptonshire Council in Northamptonshire, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The council was under Conservative control prior to the election. Reform UK won a majority of the seats at the election.

zh.s: 2025年北北安普敦郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出北北安普敦郡议会68个席位的议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。选举前，议会由保守党执政；选举后，改革英国党赢得多数席位。

en.s: The 2025 Kent County Council election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect members to Kent County Council in Kent, England. Reform UK won a majority of the 81 seats, as the Conservatives lost the vast majority of their seats including most of the Cabinet. Reform won all seats in the Ashford, Dartford, Dover, Gravesham and Thanet districts.

zh.s: 2025年肯特郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行。改革英国党赢得81个席位中的多数，保守党失去绝大多数席位，包括大部分内阁成员的席位。改革英国党赢得阿什福德、达特福德、多佛、格雷夫舍姆和萨尼特各区的全部席位。

en.s: The 2025 Shropshire Council election was held on Thursday 1 May 2025 to elect all 74 councillors to Shropshire Council in England. It took place on the same day as other council elections in the United Kingdom. Before this election Shropshire Council was held by the Conservatives, who won the previous Council election in 2021. At this election the Liberal Democrats gained majority control of the Council.

zh.s: 2025年什罗普郡议会选举于2025年5月1日星期四举行，选出英格兰什罗普郡议会全部74名议员。选举与英国其他地方议会选举同日举行。选举前，议会由保守党掌控；保守党在2021年上一次议会选举中胜出。本次选举后，自由民主党取得多数席位，掌控议会。

en.s: The PFL 4 mixed martial arts event for the 2025 season of the Professional Fighters League was held on May 1, 2025, at the Universal Studios Florida in Orlando, Florida, United States. This event marked the quarterfinal of the single-elimination tournament format in the Light Heavyweight and Heavyweight divisions.

zh.s: 职业格斗联盟2025赛季的PFL 4综合格斗赛事于2025年5月1日在美国佛罗里达州奥兰多的佛罗里达环球影城举行。本场赛事是轻重量级和重量级单败淘汰赛的四分之一决赛。

en.s: The 2025 Durham County Council election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect members to Durham County Council in County Durham, England. 98 seats were elected, a reduction from 126. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council was under no overall control prior to the election, being run by a Liberal Democrat-led coalition.

zh.s: 2025年达勒姆郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出英格兰达勒姆郡议会议员。此次选举选出98名议员，较此前的126席有所减少。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，由自由民主党牵头的联盟管理。

en.s: The 2025 Buckinghamshire Council election was held on 1 May 2025 (the same day as other local elections) to elect members to Buckinghamshire Council in Buckinghamshire, England. 97 members were elected, down from 147. Prior to the election, the council was under Conservative majority control, led by Martin Tett. Following the election, the council went under no overall control, with the Conservatives falling one seat short of a majority.

zh.s: 2025年白金汉郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，与其他地方选举同日进行，选出英格兰白金汉郡议会议员。此次选举选出97名议员，少于此前的147名。选举前，议会由马丁·泰特领导的保守党以多数席位执政。选举后，议会没有任何政党取得绝对多数；保守党仅差一席便可过半。

en.s: The 2025 City of Doncaster Council election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect all 55 members of City of Doncaster Council in Doncaster, South Yorkshire, England, alongside other nationwide local elections. Reform UK gained control of the council from Labour. At the separate mayoral election held on the same day, the incumbent Labour Mayor of Doncaster, Ros Jones, narrowly retained the mayoralty.

zh.s: 2025年唐卡斯特市议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出英格兰南约克郡唐卡斯特市议会全部55名议员，是全国地方选举的一部分。改革英国党从工党手中夺得议会控制权。同日举行的另一场市长选举中，工党现任市长罗斯·琼斯以微弱优势连任。

en.s: The 2025 Lancashire County Council election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect members to Lancashire County Council in Lancashire, England. All 84 seats were elected. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council was under Conservative majority control prior to the election. At the election, Reform UK won a majority of the seats on the council.

zh.s: 2025年兰开夏郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，全部84个席位均进行改选。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。选举前，议会由保守党以多数席位执政；选举后，改革英国党赢得多数席位。

en.s: The 2025 West Northamptonshire Council election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect 76 councillors to West Northamptonshire Council (WNC), the unitary authority that runs local government services in West Northamptonshire, England as part of nationwide local elections. This was the second election to the council since its creation in 2021, and the first conducted under its new electoral boundaries.

zh.s: 2025年西北安普敦郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出西北安普敦郡议会76名议员。该议会负责英格兰西北安普敦郡的地方公共服务。这是议会自2021年成立以来的第二次选举，也是首次按新的选区边界举行。

en.s: The 2025 Northumberland County Council election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect members to Northumberland County Council in Northumberland, England. 69 members were elected on the same day as other local elections across England. In the election the council remained under no overall control. Alongside Buckinghamshire, this was one of the only two councils where the Conservatives were elected as the largest party.

zh.s: 2025年诺森伯兰郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，共选出69名议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。选举后，议会仍没有任何政党取得绝对多数。诺森伯兰和白金汉郡是仅有的两个由保守党成为最大党的议会。

en.s: The 2025 Cambridgeshire County Council election took place on 1 May 2025 as part of the 2025 local elections in the United Kingdom. All 61 councillors were elected from 59 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The election was held alongside the election of a Mayor of Cambridgeshire and Peterborough.

zh.s: 2025年剑桥郡议会选举是英国2025年地方选举的一部分。全部61名议员从59个选区中选出，各选区按简单多数制选出一至两名郡议会议员，任期四年。选举与剑桥郡和彼得伯勒市长选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2025 Lincolnshire County Council election was held on 1 May 2025 to elect members to Lincolnshire County Council in Lincolnshire, England. All 70 seats were up for election. This was on the same day as other local elections including the inaugural 2025 Greater Lincolnshire mayoral election. The council was under Conservative majority control prior to the election.

zh.s: 2025年林肯郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出英格兰林肯郡议会议员。全部70个席位均进行改选，选举与其他地方选举同日举行，其中包括首次举行的大林肯郡市长选举。选举前，议会由保守党以多数席位执政。

en.s: The 2025 Cornwall Council election (Cornish: Etholans Konsel Kernow 2025) was held on Thursday 1 May 2025 to elect all 87 councillors to Cornwall Council. It took place on the same day as other council elections across England. The council was under no overall control prior to the election, being run by a Conservative minority administration.

zh.s: 2025年康沃尔议会选举（康沃尔语：Etholans Konsel Kernow 2025）于2025年5月1日星期四举行，选出康沃尔议会全部87名议员。选举与英格兰其他议会选举同日举行。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，由保守党少数派政府执政。

en.s: The 2025 Nottinghamshire County Council election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect members to Nottinghamshire County Council in Nottinghamshire, England. All 66 seats were elected. This was on the same day as other local elections. Reflecting national trends, the Conservatives, which had regained overall control of the council in the previous local election, experienced a significant loss of seats, resulting in the loss of its majority to Reform UK.

zh.s: 2025年诺丁汉郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出英格兰诺丁汉郡议会议员。全部66个席位均进行改选，选举与其他地方选举同日举行。与全国趋势一致，保守党在上次地方选举中重新取得议会控制权后，本次大幅失去席位，并失去多数席位，改革英国党则取得多数。

en.s: The 2025 Warwickshire County Council election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect members to Warwickshire County Council in Warwickshire, England. All 57 seats were elected. The election took place on the same day as other local elections in England. The council was under Conservative majority control prior to the election. The election saw the council go under no overall control, with Reform UK becoming the largest party.

zh.s: 2025年沃里克郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出英格兰沃里克郡议会议员。全部57个席位均进行改选，选举与英格兰其他地方选举同日举行。选举前，议会由保守党以多数席位执政。选举后，议会没有任何政党取得绝对多数，改革英国党成为最大党。

en.s: Local elections in the United Kingdom were held on 1 May 2025 for 1,641 English council seats in 24 local authorities. All seats on 14 county councils and eight unitary authorities in the United Kingdom were up for election. They were the first local elections to follow the 2024 general election. Most of these seats were last contested at the 2021 local elections.

zh.s: 2025年5月1日，英国举行地方选举，改选英格兰24个地方政府的1,641个议席。英国14个郡议会和8个单一制地方政府的全部议席都进行改选。这是2024年英国大选后的首轮地方选举，其中大多数议席上次改选是在2021年。

en.s: The 2025 Derbyshire County Council election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect members to Derbyshire County Council in Derbyshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections All 64 seats were contested under new boundaries. The Conservatives had controlled the council since the 2017 election. At the election, Reform UK won 42 seats and gained control of the council.

zh.s: 2025年德比郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出英格兰德比郡议会议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行，全部64个席位按新的选区边界改选。自2017年选举以来，保守党一直掌控议会。本次选举中，改革英国党赢得42席并取得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2025 Gloucestershire County Council election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect members to Gloucestershire County Council in England. New boundaries applied and 55 seats were elected, two more than previously. This occurred on the same day as other local elections. The council was under no overall control prior to the election, being run by a Conservative minority administration.

zh.s: 2025年格洛斯特郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出英格兰格洛斯特郡议会议员。选举采用新的选区边界，共选出55名议员，比此前增加两席。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。选举前，议会没有任何政党占多数，由保守党少数派政府执政。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Runcorn and Helsby was held on 1 May 2025, the same day as local elections in England. Following a recount, Sarah Pochin of Reform UK won the by-election with a majority of six votes, overturning a Labour majority of 14,696 votes in the last general election.

zh.t: 2025年朗科恩和赫尔斯比选区补选
zh.s: 英国议会朗科恩和赫尔斯比选区于2025年5月1日举行补选，与英格兰地方选举同日进行。重新计票后，改革英国党候选人莎拉·波钦以6票优势胜出；而在上一次大选中，工党曾以14,696票的多数优势赢得该席位。

en.s: The 2025 Devon County Council election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect members to Devon County Council in Devon, England. All 60 seats were up for election. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council was under Conservative majority control prior to the election. The council went under no overall control at the election, with the Liberal Democrats becoming the largest party.

zh.s: 2025年德文郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出德文郡议会议员。全部60个席位均进行改选，选举与其他地方选举同日举行。选举前，议会由保守党以多数席位执政。选举后，议会没有任何政党取得绝对多数，自由民主党成为最大党。

en.s: The 2025 Wiltshire Council election was held on 1 May 2025, electing members to Wiltshire Council in Wiltshire, England, one of the 2025 United Kingdom local elections. All 98 councillors, one from each division, were elected using the first-past-the-post voting system. Wiltshire was one of eight unitary authorities to hold elections in 2025, after the government delayed local elections in many other areas until 2026 as part of a plan to reorganise local government.

zh.s: 2025年威尔特郡议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出英格兰威尔特郡议会议员，是英国2025年地方选举之一。每个选区选出一名议员，共选出98名议员，采用简单多数制。威尔特郡是2025年举行选举的八个单一制地方政府之一；此前，政府以重组地方政府为由，将许多其他地区的地方选举推迟至2026年。

en.s: The 2025 Slovak Cup final (known as the Slovnaft Cup for sponsorship reasons) was the final match of the 2024–25 Slovak Cup, the 56th season of the top cup competition in Slovak football. The match was played on 1 May 2025. It was contested by MFK Ružomberok and FC Spartak Trnava. Both teams also previously met in the previous final.

zh.s: 2025年斯洛伐克杯决赛（因赞助原因称Slovnaft杯决赛）是2024—25赛季斯洛伐克杯的决赛，也是斯洛伐克足球顶级杯赛的第56个赛季。比赛于2025年5月1日举行，对阵双方是鲁容贝罗克和特尔纳瓦斯巴达克。这两支球队此前也曾在上一届决赛中交手。

en.s: The 2025 West of England mayoral election was held on 1 May 2025 to elect the mayor of the West of England on the same day as other local elections across the country. It was the third election for the role and was won by Labour's Helen Godwin. For the first time, the mayor was elected using the first-past-the-post voting system.

zh.s: 英格兰西部市长选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出英格兰西部市长，与全国其他地方选举同日进行。这是该职位设立后的第三次选举，工党候选人海伦·戈德温胜出。市长首次采用简单多数制选出。

en.s: The 2025 Doncaster mayoral election was held on the 1 May 2025 to elect the Mayor of Doncaster. Incumbent mayor Ros Jones won re-election for a fourth term, albeit with a slender majority of 698 voters. At the separate election for councillors on City of Doncaster Council on the same day, Labour lost its majority and Reform UK won an overall majority.

zh.s: 唐卡斯特市长选举于2025年5月1日举行。现任市长罗斯·琼斯以698票的微弱多数胜出，连任第四个任期。同日举行的唐卡斯特市议会选举中，工党失去多数席位，改革英国党取得绝对多数。

en.s: The 2025 Greater Lincolnshire mayoral election was held on 1 May 2025 to elect the inaugural mayor of Greater Lincolnshire, on the same day as other local elections across the country. Andrea Jenkyns of Reform UK won the election with 42% of the vote, from a turnout of 29.9%.

zh.s: 大林肯郡市长选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出首任大林肯郡市长，与全国其他地方选举同日进行。改革英国党候选人安德烈娅·詹金斯以42%的得票率胜出，投票率为29.9%。

en.s: The 2025 Cambridgeshire and Peterborough mayoral election took place on 1 May 2025 to elect the Mayor of Cambridgeshire and Peterborough. The Conservative candidate and former MP Paul Bristow won, gaining the seat from Labour. This was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2025年剑桥郡和彼得伯勒市长选举
zh.s: 剑桥郡和彼得伯勒市长选举于2025年5月1日举行。保守党候选人、前国会议员保罗·布里斯托胜出，从工党手中夺得这一职位。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。

en.t: 2025 Hull and East Yorkshire mayoral election
en.s: The 2025 Hull and East Yorkshire mayoral election was held on 1 May 2025 to elect the inaugural mayor of Hull and East Yorkshire, on the same day as other local elections across the country. The mayor was elected using first past the post. Luke Campbell of Reform UK was declared the winner on 2 May 2025.

zh.t: 2025年赫尔和东约克郡市长选举
zh.s: 赫尔和东约克郡市长选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出首任赫尔和东约克郡市长，与全国其他地方选举同日进行。选举采用简单多数制。改革英国党候选人卢克·坎贝尔于2025年5月2日被宣布胜出。

en.s: The 2025 Northampton Town Council election was held on 1 May 2025 to elect councillors to Northampton Town Council. This was the second election of Northampton Town Council having the same number of seats (25) but across only 13 wards a decrease from the previous 21.

zh.s: 北安普敦镇议会选举于2025年5月1日举行，选出北安普敦镇议会议员。这是该镇议会成立后的第二次选举，席位数仍为25个，但选区从上次的21个减少至13个。

en.s: The 2025 North Tyneside mayoral election was held on 1 May 2025 to elect the Mayor of North Tyneside. This was the mayoralty's first election since the Elections Act 2022 came into effect, and as such this election used first-past-the-post rather than supplementary vote used in previous elections. The incumbent Labour mayor Norma Redfearn, who had held the post since 2013, was not seeking re-election.

zh.s: 北泰恩赛德市长选举于2025年5月1日举行。这是《2022年选举法》生效后该市长职位的首次选举，因此改用简单多数制，不再采用以往的补充投票制。自2013年起担任市长的工党籍现任市长诺玛·雷德芬没有寻求连任。
